articles.title: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims
articles.summary: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by Saturday's attack, writes Sarah Rainsford.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims
articles.summaryTr: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by Saturday's attack, writes Sarah Rainsford.
articles.articleText: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims - Published Thousands of people joined a silent march through central Krakow on Monday night, in memory of those killed and injured when a gunman went on a violent rampage at the weekend. The crowd were led by Poland's president and prime minister, the bitter political rivals putting on a rare show of unity after the country's deadliest attack in modern times. As they reached the historic Market Square, a bugler played from the tower. Many people were carrying flowers or candles to leave at the shrines that now dot the cobblestones, each one marking a spot where someone died. Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by this attack. It has left people struggling to make some kind of sense of what happened. The alleged gunman has been named as 24-year-old Michal Oksinski by local media. Critically injured in a shoot-out with police, he did not regain consciousness and died in hospital early on Monday. Initially, the interior minister claimed that Oksinski was driven by far-right, extremist views. The national prosecutor's office now says that it is too soon to say he was "inspired" by any ideology. "The minister wanted to win domestic political points. That's not responsible behaviour," Pawel Musialek of the Jagiellonian University suggests, in a country where politics is highly - and often viciously - polarised. "So far we've seen no clear message that this guy was strongly ideological, and that it's not more like something from the darknet." There has been no mention of any letter or manifesto that Oksinski left. One neighbour told Polish news site Onet that the 24-year-old was a "bit of a loner" but few who knew him well have spoken publicly. - What we know so far after Krakow gun attack - Published17 hours ago In addition to his electronic devices like his phone, investigators are examining a number of badges that Oksinski had attached to his military-style outfit. The prosecutor's office says a yellow Gadsden flag with a coiled snake symbol was displayed in his bedroom. "It has various meanings of freedom and rebellion," a spokesman emphasised. "Not necessarily negative." It was at Oksinski's home that the bodies of his parents and sister were discovered. It is alleged that he shot them, before driving some 200km (125 miles) south to continue the killing in Krakow. Two days on, shops and cafes around the market square are beginning to fill up again, but the mood is subdued. A Zara clothes shop is still boarded up, after bullets smashed the glass. A local man in his 50s died just outside. Jo, a Scottish tourist, saw paramedics "who got there ridiculously fast", fighting to save him. "It was all pretty grim." Like many, she initially mistook the rifle shots for fireworks. On the opposite corner of the square, beside another cluster of flowers, people keep pausing to take pictures of the holes that were blasted into the wall by gunfire. One of the six victims has been identified as a Polish painter in her 50s, who was a mother of four, and in town with friends for an exhibition opening. A British citizen and an Austrian who died are yet to be named publicly. Several drivers of the horse-drawn carriages that are usually poised to trot tourists around the square were seriously injured. Olha, who works in a nearby chocolate shop says everyone is now nervous. On Saturday, people rushed into her store to escape the gunman who was tearing around in his car, firing through the window. Olha is Ukrainian, and moved to Krakow when Russia invaded. "We left our own country for safety. This is supposed to be a safe place!" she said. "It's so sad, and so scary. Especially that he drove all the way here for two hours, planning this and thinking about it." She regrets that the gunman did not survive: "So many are dead, so many lives have been ruined, and now there will be no justice." When Oksinski's car was searched, four firearms and "hundreds of rounds of ammunition" were found, all owned legally by the alleged killer and his father. Both were members of the Swit Starachowice sports club, where there is a shooting range. A spokesman recalls Michal Oksinski as unremarkable: average competition results and normal behaviour. He had been just three times this year, most recently in August with his father. The club spokesman is adamant that it does not train combat firing, only shooting from a fixed point. Gun ownership in Poland has grown considerably since war broke out in Ukraine just across the border, but this is the first mass shooting anyone here can remember. Inevitably, it has brought scrutiny of the checks over who qualifies to handle such weapons, including psychological tests, as Michal Oksinski passed all of them. On Monday, the government announced an urgent review. At the spot where Oksinski's car was intercepted and he was shot by police there is another memorial, this one in honour of the officers still in hospital. Some have brought flowers, but a girl called Bianka has left a card that reads: "Thank you Mr Policemen, get better soon." A couple of steps away, there's a series of bullet holes in the glass. "This man was a real hero, he didn't hesitate," Ania says, referring to officer Jakub Kulik who was shot in the chest. His condition remains serious. "We're here to help him fight for his life." "Nothing like this has never happened before, it's terrible," a young man called Wojtek tells me. He's only glad that the gunman responsible for such horror turned out to be Polish. "People here are already against immigration, so that would have been even worse." Ania thinks Poles will pull through, though the country's image as a low-crime oasis has been shattered. Most of all, she's angry that Michal Oksinski died without being held to account for the devastation. "I think we deserve to know why." - Published2 days ago - Published21 hours ago - Published1 day ago

articles.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
articles.summary: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
articles.summaryTr: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.
articles.articleText: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses. Update (Nov. 10, 2026, 7:31 am UTC): This article has been updated to include details of MARA’s $1.1 billion Bitcoin sale and its repayment of $750 million in Bitcoin-backed loans. HIVE Digital Technologies and MARA Holdings mined more Bitcoin in the September quarter than a year earlier but reported lower mining revenue, as weaker Bitcoin prices outweighed gains in production. According to their latest regulatory filings, HIVE’s Bitcoin production increased 49% to 1,070 Bitcoin (BTC), while mining revenue fell 7.4% to $76 million. MARA reported a similar pattern, with production rising 5% to 2,247 BTC and Bitcoin mining revenue dropping 34% to $159 million. MARA also disclosed that it sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1 billion after the quarter ended Sept. 30. It used $750 million of the proceeds to repay its Bitcoin-backed term loans in full, releasing 17,477 BTC it had pledged as collateral. Both companies reported higher power bills and equipment charges. HIVE’s electricity costs rose 20% to $45.6 million, while MARA’s purchased energy costs increased 12% to $48.1 million as it expanded its owned mining operations. HIVE also recorded a $31.2 million noncash write-down on mining equipment, citing “depressed mining economics,” while MARA separately wrote off $12 million involving mining rigs and equipment under restructuring plans. Both results add to signs of pressure on Bitcoin mining economics. American Bitcoin last week reported weaker mining margins despite a treasury-driven quarterly profit, while Core Scientific said it plans to leave mining entirely by year-end. HIVE and MARA expand AI businesses alongside mining Unlike Core Scientific, HIVE and MARA are both continuing to invest in Bitcoin mining alongside artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. HIVE’s HPC hosting revenue rose 71% to $8.8 million in the September quarter, accounting for 10.4% of total revenue. The company has described its strategy as combining cash flow from mining with recurring revenue from AI infrastructure. Related: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI HIVE said it anticipates spending up to $493 million over 36 months to expand its HPC operations, including acquiring land, building out data center infrastructure and buying up GPUs. The company reported spending $145.3 million toward that expansion as of the filing. HIVE also plans to spend about $35 million converting its Toronto facility into a Tier-III data center. Meanwhile, it continues to expand its mining infrastructure, targeting a 100-megawatt substation expansion at its Yguazú site in Paraguay during 2026. MARA is also developing AI infrastructure through its Exaion subsidiary and a partnership with Starwood Digital Ventures. It said it intends to operate sites that can shift between workloads depending on economics, demand and grid conditions, with Bitcoin mining remaining the foundation of its platform. Treasury gains lift MARA profit, HIVE reports quarterly loss HIVE’s Nasdaq-listed shares fell 1.7% to $1.78 in after-hours trading Monday, according to Google Finance, after closing the regular session up 1.7% at $1.81. The company reported fiscal second-quarter revenue of $84.9 million, down 2.7% from a year earlier but above the $79.4 million consensus estimate listed by MarketBeat. Meanwhile, MARA reported net income attributable to common stockholders of $634.4 million, up from $123.1 million a year earlier, and included substantial fair-value gains on digital assets and digital asset receivables. MARA reported quarterly revenue of $164.2 million, down 35% year-on-year, and diluted earnings of $1.28 a share, up from 27 cents, while its shares were little changed at $6.64 in after-hours trading Monday after closing up 4.6%. Magazine: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
articles.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.summary: Huang, who is now being investigated over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, is far more important to the future of the world order than other tech bosses.

news.titleTr: Faisal Islam: What the boss of US tech giant Nvidia told me about China and national security
news.summaryTr: Huang, who is now being investigated over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, is far more important to the future of the world order than other tech bosses.
news.articleText: Faisal Islam: What the boss of US tech giant Nvidia told me about China and national security - Published Jensen Huang has the air of the late Steve Jobs about him. I have interviewed both, and the up-close charisma - and occasionally scratchy genius - is shared. Both sported a signature item of black clothing, although Huang opts for a leather jacket rather than the Apple founder's turtle neck. Both are innovators revered in the tech world. However, Huang is now being investigated over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Everything you have heard about Artificial Intelligence (AI) over the past few months - good, bad, revolutionary and catastrophic - is dependent on having the most powerful frontier AI models. In turn they depend on the most powerful microchips, and for years that has been this very company, Nvidia, led by Huang, and his technology rooted in repurposed games graphics and the manufacturing prowess of Taiwan. Names such as Gracehopper, Vera and Rubin mean almost nothing to the public, but are the names of chips powering the creation of AI models transforming the world. I met Huang as he held court with reporters and offered words of encouragement for the UK's tech future during US President Donald Trump's state visit to the UK in September last year. It was also right in the middle of his attempts to get Trump to lift export bans to China of some of the highest performing AI chips, specifically the H200. An export ban on a less powerful chip had already been lifted. He was, I suggested to him, one of the few people who could walk into the White House to meet Trump, and a few days later meet President Xi Jinping in Beijing. He made no secret of his views, nor his assessment that he had persuaded Trump of his case. "President Trump is very clear. He wants America to win and and President Xi wants China to win, and it's possible for both of them too. And the reason for that is because it's not a zero-sum game. The advance of human society is not a zero-sum game." He is probably the only person in the world that could have spoken that sentence with the authority that he might have heard personally from both these superpower leaders. Differing views on security risks However, his view about "zero-sum game" is not backed by many in national security circles. Their view is that the race to the most advanced forms of AI is entirely zero sum, and requires the West - and the US in particular - to take critical action to hold back Chinese advancement. The country that creates the most powerful AI systems, from the most powerful chips, will win, in terms of scientific development, of cracking encryption, economic growth and cyber-weapons. He made a further argument: Far from being a national security challenge, it was, in fact, better for the US that the world "including China" became dependent on US systems, what they called the "American tech stack", with Nvidia chips at its core. Huang then went even further than that, saying that President Trump "is very clear-eyed" about the idea that "this computing technology is not a national security concern". He told me "any military is smart enough to build their military on top of their own indigenous technology, and not rely on an adversary to build their technology, build their military capability". What does this show us? At that time, which is the same moment now being independently investigated over national security concerns and alleged Chinese espionage, Huang was making clear public arguments to lift export bans, and seemed to have a clear idea of President Trump's views. More than that, he was also disputing the idea that his technology, in China's hands, was any type of national security concern. Nvidia is the absolute epicentre of the AI tech boom in the US and of the global race for AI supremacy. Even if the boom turned to bust, Nvidia is still expected to remain in rude health. It has actual hard revenues of about $400bn this year. Monday's drop of about 4% of its value reflects new and extraordinary risks at this junction of tech and global politics, but the chipmaker is still worth more than $4 trillion. - Published1 hour ago - Published13 hours ago - Published9 hours ago

news.titleTr: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
news.summaryTr: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.
news.articleText: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash - Published Kim Kardashian's Skims is offering customers refunds for its $148 (£110) advent calendar which has been widely criticised on social media. The accessories advent calendar promised "twelve days of fun surprises" but has been mocked online for the quality of its contents, such as hair clips and keychains, with some comparing them to something you would find down the back of a sofa. A spokesperson for Skims has told a number of media outlets "for some, the calendar didn't meet expectations" and the company has "personally contacted every customer" to offer a full refund or credit to put towards other products". The BBC has contacted Skims for comment. The shapewear and clothing business was co-founder by Kardashian in 2019 and has made the reality TV star a billionaire, according to Forbes magazine. Skims was valued at $5bn in 2025 when it raised millions of dollars in new funding.

news.title: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
news.summary: Kyiv, Washington and Moscow have all sent delegations to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

news.titleTr: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
news.summaryTr: Kyiv, Washington and Moscow have all sent delegations to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
news.articleText: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say - Published Trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have begun in Abu Dhabi. Although expectations for a breakthrough that ends Russia's full-scale war on Ukraine are low, US officials said yesterday that Moscow and Kyiv were privately showing "a little bit of flexibility" on the issue of who would control Ukraine's eastern regions in a postwar scenario. Jared Kushner - Donald Trump's son-in-law and part of the US delegation alongside peace envoy Steve Witkoff - said the talks would be focused on addressing the "postwar security concerns" of both Russia and Ukraine. "An important part of this process is encouraging all parties to begin thinking seriously about what comes after the war," Kushner wrote on X. Ahead of the meeting, the two US envoys met Ukrainian and European and Nato officials in Abu Dhabi, and French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot was adamant that France, the UK and Germany "will indeed be in the meeting room". European officials are wary of Russia trying to secure a deal with the US on future "collective security" without them, and Moscow and Kyiv's positions on ending the conflict are still far apart. A key area of disagreement between the two involves Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is by now mostly occupied by Russia. Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk which it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those sections, which it says are crucial to its future security. While neither side has budged on these demands, the US official speaking on the eve of the talks suggested that this was just the public stance and that Moscow and Kyiv had shown "a little bit of flexibility, privately". However, he acknowledged that the issue would not be solved without discussions about a new "security architecture". "They will not solve the Donetsk issue and the territorial issue until they know what the security architecture is going to be after the war," the official said. "And keep in mind, we're not going to be able to finalise one without the other." For Ukraine, a post-war "security architecture" may include reassurance that allies will come to its aid if it's attacked again. For Russia, that could be its longstanding ambition to see Nato roll back from eastern Europe – which would be alarming to Europeans. The framework being proposed includes security consultations and crisis communications hotlines, as well as "reciprocal de-escalation measures" between the two. The officials also floated the re-activation of the Nato-Russia Council that has been largely paused since 2022. The last round of trilateral talks, held in Geneva in February, ended without a breakthrough. Soon after, the US-Israel war on Iran diverted Washington's attention from Ukraine, and no other discussions were held since. Since then, European leaders - who have been largely excluded from peace talks – have pushed to be involved in the process amid concerns that decisions about the security of their continent would be made without them. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen urged on Monday to include Nato allies and EU members into any "meaningful discussions about Europe's security architecture". President Volodymyr Zelensky has repeatedly stated Kyiv wanted Europe to be part of the talks. The US official said the Americans would propose moving into a multilateral format bringing the Europeans into the discussion. "Hopefully we'll get the Russians on board," the official said, while acknowledging that "the Russians have a bad taste in their mouth with the Europeans." Since the start of his second term in office, US President Donald Trump – who once boasted he could end the war in Ukraine within a day – has spearheaded several rounds of talks to end the conflict, albeit with little success. Meanwhile, his increasingly conciliatory approach towards Moscow has fuelled deep unease in Kyiv and across the European Union. After meeting Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington last week, Trump touted a forthcoming "big, beautiful agreement" on Ukraine which "might involve all of Europe". Many in Ukraine are sceptical that this would result into a fair peace. Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Merezhko, head of the foreign affairs parliamentary committee, told the BBC he believes Trump wants "a quick deal at the expense of Ukraine", which will certainly be rejected by Kyiv. The only way to make Putin start real negotiations is by putting greater pressure on Russia through sanctions and deep strikes, Merezhko said. "While Putin has a war machine up and running, he has no incentives to negotiate." He also mentioned recent moves by Trump, such as his deal to buy diesel from Russia, as something that "only encourages Moscow to continue the war". Moscow's delegation in Abu Dhabi will include Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, spy chief Igor Kostyukov and army general Yury Zhigarlovsky. Kyiv is sending several senior officials who have been part of previous negotiating teams, including Foreign Intelligence Service head Rustem Umerov, Volodymyr Zelensky's chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov, and MP Davyd Arakhamiya. Away from Abu Dhabi, Russia continues to pummel Ukraine with deadly bombardments and strikes on energy infrastructure, viewed in Kyiv as proof Moscow wants to corner Ukraine into accepting a deal on Russia's terms. On Monday, Kushner was cautious to point out that the Abu Dhabi talks could at most "build momentum toward the next phase of negotiations." "This is an extraordinarily difficult and complicated conflict," he wrote on X, adding the US was "approaching these discussions with determination and realism." Since the start of his second term in office, US President Donald Trump – who once boasted he could end the war in Ukraine within a day – has spearheaded several rounds of talks to end the conflict, albeit with little success. Meanwhile, his increasingly conciliatory approach towards Moscow has fuelled deep unease in Kyiv and across the European Union. After meeting Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington last week, Trump touted a forthcoming "big, beautiful agreement" on Ukraine which "might involve all of Europe". Many in Ukraine are sceptical that this would result into a fair peace. Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Merezhko, head of the foreign affairs parliamentary committee, told the BBC he believes Trump wants "a quick deal at the expense of Ukraine", which will certainly be rejected by Kyiv. The only way to make Putin start real negotiations is by putting greater pressure on Russia through sanctions and deep strikes, Merezhko said. "While Putin has a war machine up and running, he has no incentives to negotiate." He also mentioned recent moves by Trump, such as his deal to buy diesel from Russia, as something that "only encourages Moscow to continue the war". Moscow's delegation in Abu Dhabi will include Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, spy chief Igor Kostyukov and army general Yury Zhigarlovsky. Kyiv is sending several senior officials who have been part of previous negotiating teams, including Foreign Intelligence Service head Rustem Umerov, Volodymyr Zelensky's chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov, and MP Davyd Arakhamiya. Away from Abu Dhabi, Russia continues to pummel Ukraine with deadly bombardments and strikes on energy infrastructure, viewed in Kyiv as proof Moscow wants to corner Ukraine into accepting a deal on Russia's terms. On Monday, Kushner was cautious to point out that the Abu Dhabi talks could at most "build momentum toward the next phase of negotiations." "This is an extraordinarily difficult and complicated conflict," he wrote on X, adding the US was "approaching these discussions with determination and realism." news.title: Bir günlük grevin Avrupa ekonomilerine maliyeti: Almanya ilk sırada
news.summary: Euronews'ün Eurostat verileri üzerinden yaptığı hesaplamaya göre, çalışanların yüzde 20'sinin bir gün iş bırakması Almanya'da 2,5 milyar, Fransa'da 1,6 milyar ve İtalya'da 1,2 milyar euroluk üretim kaybına yol açabilir. Sık tekrarlanan grevler ise ekonomik maliyeti artırıyor.

news.titleTr: Bir günlük grevin Avrupa ekonomilerine maliyeti: Almanya ilk sırada
news.summaryTr: Euronews'ün Eurostat verileri üzerinden yaptığı hesaplamaya göre, çalışanların yüzde 20'sinin bir gün iş bırakması Almanya'da 2,5 milyar, Fransa'da 1,6 milyar ve İtalya'da 1,2 milyar euroluk üretim kaybına yol açabilir. Sık tekrarlanan grevler ise ekonomik maliyeti artırıyor.
news.articleText: Bir günlük grevin Avrupa ekonomilerine maliyeti: Almanya ilk sırada - Euronews'ün Eurostat verileri üzerinden yaptığı hesaplamaya göre, çalışanların yüzde 20'sinin bir gün iş bırakması Almanya'da 2,5 milyar, Fransa'da 1,6 milyar ve İtalya'da 1,2 milyar euroluk üretim kaybına yol açabilir. Sık tekrarlanan grevler ise ekonomik maliyeti artırıyor. Avrupa'da grevlerin ekonomilere maliyeti ülkelerin ekonomik büyüklüğüne ve iş bırakma eylemlerinin sıklığına göre değişiyor. Euronews'ün Eurostat'ın 2025 yılı gayrisafi yurt içi hasıla (GSYH) verileri üzerinden yaptığı hesaplamaya göre, çalışanların yüzde 20'sinin bir gün iş bırakması halinde Almanya ekonomisinde yaklaşık 2,5 milyar euroluk üretim kaybı yaşanabilir. Almanya'yı 1,6 milyar euroyla Fransa, 1,2 milyar euroyla İtalya izliyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İspanya'da 2012'den bu yana iki büyük sendikanın birlikte düzenlediği ilk genel grev öncesinde yayımlanan analizde, Avrupa ülkelerinin grevlerden kaynaklanabilecek ekonomik kayıpları karşılaştırıldı. Hesaplamada ülkelerin yıllık GSYH'si 365'e bölünerek günlük ekonomik üretim tahmin edildi. Ardından çalışanların yüzde 20'sinin iş bırakması ve bu kesimin günlük üretimin yaklaşık beşte birini gerçekleştirdiği varsayıldı. Bu yönteme göre İspanya'da bir günlük grevin ekonomik maliyetinin yaklaşık 930 milyon euro olması bekleniyor. Ülkenin 2025'teki 1,69 trilyon euroluk ekonomik üretimi, günlük ortalama 4,6 milyar euroya karşılık geliyor. Daha küçük ekonomilerde tahmini kayıp da azalıyor. Aynı büyüklükteki bir grevin Belçika ekonomisine yaklaşık 350 milyon euro, Portekiz ekonomisine ise 170 milyon euroya mal olabileceği hesaplanıyor. Grevlerin etkisi birkaç ay içinde telafi edilebiliyor Haberdeki hesaplamaların yaklaşık tahminler olduğu, grevlerin ekonomik etkisinin sektörlere göre farklılaştığı vurgulanıyor. Ulaşım, eğitim ve kamu hizmetlerinde faaliyetler daha fazla aksarken fabrikalar ve ofislerin önemli bir bölümü çalışmayı sürdürebiliyor. Fransa Merkez Bankası'nın 2023'teki emeklilik reformu karşıtı grevlere ilişkin hesaplaması, ekonomik kayıpların bir bölümünün sonraki aylarda telafi edilebildiğini gösteriyor. Banka, Mart ve Nisan 2023'teki grevlerin ilk çeyrekte ekonomik büyümeyi yaklaşık 0,1 puan düşürdüğünü, ikinci çeyrekte ise benzer büyüklükte bir toparlanma yaşandığını belirledi. Böylece kaybedilen ekonomik faaliyetin büyük bölümü üç ay içinde geri kazanıldı. Benzer şekilde Fransa Ulusal İstatistik ve Ekonomik Araştırmalar Enstitüsü (INSEE), 2018 baharındaki toplumsal eylemlerin GSYH'yi yaklaşık 0,1 puan azalttığını hesapladı. Ancak bazı kayıpların telafi edilmesi mümkün olmuyor. Greve katılan çalışanlar bir günlük ücretlerinden vazgeçerken, gerçekleşmeyen ekonomik faaliyetlerden vergi geliri elde edilemiyor. İptal edilen uçuşlar ve boş kalan otel odaları da sonradan telafi edilemeyen kayıplar arasında yer alıyor. Belçika'da grevlerin tekrarlanması dikkat çekiyor Avrupa Sendikalar Enstitüsü (ETUI) verileri, grevlerin sıklığının ekonomik etkiler açısından belirleyici olduğunu ortaya koyuyor. Belçika'da 2025 yılında grevler nedeniyle 1 milyon 354 bin 845 iş günü kaybedildi. Her 1000 çalışan başına 313 iş gününe karşılık gelen bu rakam, 1993'te kaydedilen 299 günlük önceki rekoru geride bıraktı. Hollanda'da geçen yıl 23 grev nedeniyle yaklaşık 60 bin iş günü kaybedildi. Almanya'da ise Ekonomik ve Sosyal Araştırmalar Enstitüsü (WSI), 2025'te grevlerden kaynaklanan kaybın yaklaşık 645 bin iş günü olduğunu hesapladı. Haberde, tek seferlik grevlerin ekonomik etkisinin sonraki dönemlerde telafi edilebildiği ancak sık tekrarlanan iş bırakma eylemlerinin üretim üzerinde daha kalıcı sonuçlar doğurabildiği değerlendiriliyor. İspanya'da grevin etkisi elektrik tüketiminden izlenecek İspanya'da 2012'deki genel grev sırasında katılımın ölçülmesinde elektrik tüketimi verilerinden yararlanılmıştı. İçişleri Bakanlığı, elektrik şebekesi işletmecisi Red Eléctrica'nın verilerine dayanarak sabahın erken saatlerinde elektrik talebinin normal seviyenin yüzde 11,4 altında kaldığını açıklamıştı. Mart 2012'deki grevde aynı saatte düşüş yüzde 15,4 olarak ölçülmüştü. Bu yılki grevde de elektrik tüketimi verilerinin katılıma ilişkin ilk göstergelerden biri olması bekleniyor. Sendikalar ve hükümetin açıklayacağı katılım rakamlarının ise birbirinden farklı olabileceği belirtiliyor. İspanya'daki grev, 29 Kasım'da yapılacak erken genel seçimden 18 gün önce düzenleniyor. Ülkede CCOO ve UGT sendikaları, çarşamba günü 24 saatlik genel grev çağrısında bulundu. Borsalar grevden etkilenmedi Grev çağrısına rağmen yatırımcıların İspanya piyasalarına yönelik belirgin bir tepki vermediği görülüyor. IBEX 35 endeksi pazartesi gününü 19 bin 742,5 puandan tamamladı. Endeks yıl başından bu yana yüzde 14,1 yükselirken tarihi zirvesinin yaklaşık yüzde 3 altında bulunuyor. Greve maruz kalabilecek şirketlerin hisselerinde de yıl genelinde yükseliş kaydedildi. İspanyol otel zinciri Meliá Hotels International'ın hisseleri yüzde 38, havalimanı işletmecisi Aena'nın hisseleri ise yüzde 21 değer kazandı. Euronews'ün değerlendirmesine göre, tek günlük grevlerin etkisi çoğunlukla geçici kalabilirken Belçika örneği, sık tekrarlanan iş bırakma eylemlerinin ekonomi üzerinde daha kalıcı bir yük oluşturabileceğine işaret ediyor.

news.title: Hangi fon kazandırdı, hangisinden para çıktı? İşte haftanın tablosu
news.summary: Yatırım fonlarında 3-9 Kasım döneminin getiri ve para akışı tablosu belli oldu. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL giriş yaşanırken bazı fonlardan milyarlarca lira çıkış gerçekleşti. Peki, haftanın en çok kazandıran fonları hangileri oldu, yatırımcılar hangi fonlara yöneldi?

news.titleTr: Hangi fon kazandırdı, hangisinden para çıktı? İşte haftanın tablosu
news.summaryTr: Yatırım fonlarında 3-9 Kasım döneminin getiri ve para akışı tablosu belli oldu. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL giriş yaşanırken bazı fonlardan milyarlarca lira çıkış gerçekleşti. Peki, haftanın en çok kazandıran fonları hangileri oldu, yatırımcılar hangi fonlara yöneldi?
news.articleText: Hangi fon kazandırdı, hangisinden para çıktı? İşte haftanın tablosu - Yatırım fonlarında 3-9 Kasım döneminin getiri ve para akışı tablosu belli oldu. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL giriş yaşanırken bazı fonlardan milyarlarca lira çıkış gerçekleşti. Peki, haftanın en çok kazandıran fonları hangileri oldu, yatırımcılar hangi fonlara yöneldi? Yatırım fonlarında 3-9 Kasım dönemine ilişkin para akışı verileri, yatırımcıların tercihlerinde para piyasası fonlarının öne çıktığını gösterdi. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL net giriş yaşanırken, serbest fonlar ve kıymetli maden fonlarından çıkış kaydedildi. Haftalık getirilerde ise bazı para piyasası fonları yüzde 0,73'ün üzerine çıktı. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL giriş CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 3-9 Kasım döneminde yatırım fonlarına toplam 8,3 milyar TL net para girişi gerçekleşti. Fon türleri arasında en yüksek giriş 28 milyar TL ile para piyasası fonlarında yaşandı. Para piyasası fonlarını 5,5 milyar TL ile serbest-hisse ve diğer fonlar, 1,7 milyar TL ile borçlanma araçları fonları izledi. Aynı dönemde en yüksek çıkış 20,6 milyar TL ile serbest-P/P kısa vadeli fonlarda gerçekleşti. Kıymetli maden fonlarından 3,4 milyar TL, değişken fonlardan 1 milyar TL, fon sepeti fonlarından ise 900 milyon TL çıkış yaşandı. Hisse senedi fonlarında 500 milyon TL, serbest-döviz fonlarında 400 milyon TL net çıkış kaydedildi. Para piyasası fonlarında en yüksek getiri hangisinde? Para piyasası fonlarının haftalık getiri sıralamasında İnveo Portföy tarafından yönetilen IPY fonu yüzde 0,7384 getiriyle ilk sırada yer aldı. IPY'nin mevduat eşdeğeri yıllık getiri oranı yüzde 38,50 olarak gösterildi. İkinci sırada yüzde 0,7349 haftalık getiriyle Atlas Portföy'ün PTP fonu bulunurken, Yapı Kredi Portföy'ün PPI fonu yüzde 0,7331 getiriyle üçüncü oldu. Nurol Portföy'ün PPN fonu yüzde 0,7288, Aktif Portföy'ün IDL fonu yüzde 0,7263 ve Ziraat Portföy'ün ZBJ fonu yüzde 0,7241 haftalık getiri sağladı. Garanti Portföy'ün GPZ fonunda haftalık getiri yüzde 0,7188, Deniz Portföy'ün DL2 fonunda yüzde 0,7168 ve Osmanlı Portföy'ün PLR fonunda yüzde 0,7112 olarak gerçekleşti. 5 fonun haftalık getirileri yüzde 0,7018 ile yüzde 0,7384 arasında değişirken, mevduat eşdeğeri yıllık getiri oranları yüzde 36,60 ile yüzde 38,50 arasında sıralandı. En fazla para girişi ve çıkışı yaşanan fonlar Fon bazında para akışında en yüksek giriş 18,46 milyar TL ile BGP fonunda gerçekleşti. BGP'yi 9,65 milyar TL ile ZBJ, 6,80 milyar TL ile KSV ve 3,70 milyar TL ile DLY takip etti. ZJI ve ZJB fonlarına ayrı ayrı 3,63 milyar TL giriş yaşanırken, KTV fonuna 2,53 milyar TL, ONS fonuna 2 milyar TL, DZM fonuna 1,80 milyar TL ve EUZ fonuna 1,47 milyar TL giriş kaydedildi. En fazla para çıkışı yaşanan fon ise 5,41 milyar TL ile DCB oldu. Bu fonu 3,09 milyar TL ile ZPR, 2,97 milyar TL ile KZL ve 2,85 milyar TL ile ONK izledi. news.title: ABD'den Lyft'e 53 milyon dolarlık dava: Engelli yolculara ayrımcılık suçlaması
news.summary: ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, engelli yolculara ayrımcılık yaptığı iddiasıyla ulaşım şirketi Lyft'e karşı 53 milyon dolarlık dava açtı. Şirket, hizmet hayvanı ve hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihaz kullanan yolculara hizmet vermemekle suçlanıyor.

news.titleTr: ABD'den Lyft'e 53 milyon dolarlık dava: Engelli yolculara ayrımcılık suçlaması
news.summaryTr: ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, engelli yolculara ayrımcılık yaptığı iddiasıyla ulaşım şirketi Lyft'e karşı 53 milyon dolarlık dava açtı. Şirket, hizmet hayvanı ve hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihaz kullanan yolculara hizmet vermemekle suçlanıyor.
news.articleText: ABD'den Lyft'e 53 milyon dolarlık dava: Engelli yolculara ayrımcılık suçlaması - ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, engelli yolculara ayrımcılık yaptığı iddiasıyla ulaşım şirketi Lyft'e karşı 53 milyon dolarlık dava açtı. - Şirket, hizmet hayvanı ve hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihaz kullanan yolculara hizmet vermemekle suçlanıyor. ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, ulaşım platformu Lyft hakkında engelli yolculara yönelik ayrımcılık iddiaları nedeniyle hukuki süreç başlattı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bakanlık, şirkete karşı 53 milyon dolar tutarında dava açtı. Dava dilekçesinde, Lyft ve sürücülerinin engelli yolcuların taşınmasını rutin olarak reddettiği öne sürüldü. Şirketin özellikle hizmet hayvanı kullanan veya hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihazlarla seyahat eden bireylere hizmet vermediği iddia edildi. Başvuruda ayrıca, hizmet talepleri hukuka aykırı şekilde reddedilen yolculardan iptal ücreti gibi ek bedeller tahsil edildiği belirtildi. Adalet Bakanlığı, Lyft'in engelli yolculara yönelik ayrımcılığı önlemek için gerekli durumlarda şirket kurallarında makul düzenlemeler yapmayı da reddettiğini ileri sürdü. ABD'de engelli bireylerin ulaşım hizmetlerine eşit erişimi, Engelli Amerikalılar Yasası (ADA) kapsamında korunuyor. Yasa, hizmet sağlayıcıların engelli bireylere yönelik ayrımcılık yapmasını yasaklıyor.

news.titleTr: Honda'dan yeni hibrit SUV hamlesi: Avancier ilk kez görüntülendi
news.summaryTr: Japon otomobil üreticisi Honda, yeni hibrit SUV modeli Avancier'in tasarımına ilişkin ilk ipuçlarını paylaştı. Üç sıra koltuk düzeniyle geniş aileleri hedeflemesi beklenen yeni model, markanın geliştirdiği hibrit teknolojisiyle yollara çıkmaya hazırlanıyor.
news.articleText: Honda'dan yeni hibrit SUV hamlesi: Avancier ilk kez görüntülendi - Japon otomobil üreticisi Honda, yeni hibrit SUV modeli Avancier'in tasarımına ilişkin ilk ipuçlarını paylaştı. Üç sıra koltuk düzeniyle geniş aileleri hedeflemesi beklenen yeni model, markanın geliştirdiği hibrit teknolojisiyle yollara çıkmaya hazırlanıyor. Honda'nın sosyal medya üzerinden yayımladığı tanıtım görseli, Avancier'in tasarım çizgilerini ortaya koydu. Station wagon modellerini andıran uzun gövde yapısını SUV özellikleriyle birleştiren otomobil, modern ve sportif görünümüyle dikkat çekiyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yeni modelde ince tasarımlı ön farlar, gövde boyunca uzanan belirgin omuz çizgisi ve L biçimindeki arka aydınlatmalar öne çıkıyor. Eğimli bagaj kapağı da otomobilin dinamik görünümünü tamamlıyor. Yeni hibrit teknolojisiyle gelecek Honda, Avancier'in yeni nesil Honda Hybrid güç aktarma sistemiyle donatılacağını doğruladı. Markanın mevcut e:HEV teknolojisinden farklı bir adlandırmayla duyurduğu sistemin teknik özelliklerinin kasım ayı içerisinde açıklanması bekleniyor. Otomobilin motor gücü, batarya kapasitesi, yakıt tüketimi ve performans değerleri hakkında ise henüz resmi bir bilgi bulunmuyor. Honda'dan 15 yeni hibrit model planı Avancier, Honda'nın önümüzdeki yıllara yönelik hibrit otomobil stratejisinin önemli parçalarından biri olacak. Şirket, 2027 yılından Mart 2030 sonuna kadar küresel pazarda 15 yeni nesil hibrit modeli satışa sunmayı hedefliyor. Bu araçlarda kullanılacak ortak platformun mevcut mimarilere kıyasla daha hafif ve daha dayanıklı olması planlanıyor. Honda ayrıca yeni hibrit modellerinde kullanılmak üzere elektrik destekli dört tekerlekten çekiş sistemi üzerinde çalışıyor. Ancak söz konusu teknolojinin Avancier'de yer alıp almayacağı henüz netleşmedi. 2027'de satışa çıkabilir Avancier ismi Honda için yeni değil. Marka, aynı adı ilk kez 1999 yılında Japonya pazarında satışa sunduğu Accord temelli station wagon modelinde kullanmıştı. Yeni Avancier ise üç sıra koltuklu SUV olarak farklı bir segmentte konumlanacak. Bölgesel basında yer alan bilgilere göre otomobilin 2027 yılında Avustralya'da satışa sunulması bekleniyor. Üretim için Tayland seçeneğinin değerlendirildiği de öne sürülüyor. Honda, modelin hangi ülkelerde satışa çıkacağını ve resmi lansman tarihini henüz duyurmadı.

news.title: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards'
news.summary: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards'
news.summaryTr: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.
news.articleText: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards' - Published At least 66 soldiers have been sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of Congo for cowardice, mutiny and refusing to obey orders, local media report. The sentences followed a trial of 71 soldiers before a military court in Walikale, in North Kivu province, in eastern DR Congo. Four soldiers were acquitted, while another was sentenced to 10 years in prison. The army said the trial was intended to improve discipline among troops as they battle armed groups in eastern DR Congo. The region has endured decades of conflict, with fighting continuing between government forces and the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), a rebel coalition that includes the M23 group. The soldiers were reportedly arrested on 20 October in Walikale, where they were accused of abandoning their positions and fleeing during clashes with FRN fighters. The Congolese army's campaign against armed groups, including the M23, has long been undermined by poor discipline and disorganisation within its ranks. The government has repeatedly accused neighbouring Rwanda of supporting the M23, an allegation denied by both Kigali and the rebels despite overwhelming evidence. The army has faced persistent criticism over its lack of professionalism and disciplined, while soldiers have complained of poor pay and inadequate equipment. Last month, another 27 soldiers were sentenced to death on similar charges of cowardice after reportedly withdrawing from the frontline during clashes with rebels. In March 2024, DR Congo lifted a 20-year moratorium on the death penalty, citing the need to remove "traitors" within the army. The government said capital punishment would also apply to people involved in armed groups, insurrection, as well as committing treason and war crimes. The decision to reinstate the death penalty was widely criticised by rights groups. However, no formal executions have been carried out since the moratorium was lifted. Since the beginning of 2025, at least 507 soldiers have been convicted, including 381 death sentences, according to figures compiled by French broadcaster RFI. In October 2025, former Congolese President Joseph Kabila was sentenced to death in absentia on charges including war crimes and treason. He denied the accusations, but did not appear in court to defend himself. He has since been named as the FRN's leader. Avrupa borsaları, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını belirtmesinin ardından petrol fiyatlarının gerilemesiyle güne yükselişle başladı. Bölge genelindeki alımlarla STOXX 600 endeksi rekor seviyesine yaklaştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa'nın gösterge endeksi STOXX 600, saat 11.05 itibarıyla yüzde 0,9 artışla 662,54 puana yükseldi. Almanya'da DAX, Fransa'da CAC 40 ve İtalya'da FTSE MIB endeksleri de yaklaşık yüzde 1 değer kazandı. STOXX 600, Ortadoğu'daki çatışmanın sona erebileceğine yönelik beklentilerin etkisiyle ağustos ayı başında gördüğü tarihi zirvenin yüzde 1'den daha az altında işlem gördü. Bölgedeki gerilimin azalabileceğine ilişkin beklentiler, enerji kaynaklı enflasyonun yavaşlayabileceği ve merkez bankalarının faiz artırımı baskısının hafifleyebileceği öngörülerini güçlendirdi. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı, Trump'ın açıklamalarının ardından yüzde 2'den fazla gerileyerek 90 dolar seviyesine indi. Petrol fiyatlarındaki düşüş, yüksek yakıt maliyetleriyle mücadele eden havacılık şirketlerinin hisselerine de olumlu yansıdı. Lufthansa hisseleri yüzde 1,8, Air France-KLM hisseleri yüzde 1,2 yükseldi. Şirket hisselerinde son durum Şirket bazında ise çip üreticisi Infineon'un hisseleri yüzde 3,1 değer kazandı. Şirket, veri merkezleri, enerji altyapısı ve yazılım tanımlı araçlardan gelen talebin etkisiyle 2027'de gelirlerinde yüzde 20'den fazla büyüme ve kârlılığında yaklaşık 5 puanlık artış beklediğini açıkladı. Gübre üreticisi K+S'nin hisseleri de üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarının piyasa beklentilerini aşmasının ardından yüzde 2,3 yükseldi. Not: Reuters'ın haberinde endeksin 662,54 puanlık seviyesi saat 08.05 GMT itibarıyla veriliyor. Bu nedenle metinde saat bilgisi yerine seans içi yükseliş aktarıldı.

news.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
news.summary: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
news.summaryTr: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
news.articleText: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published US President Donald Trump has said the FBI is investigating the affair between the chief executive of Nvidia and an alleged Chinese spy. Trump said he spoke to Jensen Huang on Monday following reports that the US believed he had been targeted in a Chinese espionage campaign. "I asked him that question, 'Did you have any idea she was a spy?' He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. Beijing has rejected claims that Huang was targeted, with its foreign ministry saying the allegations were "entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China". Speaking later at a White House press briefing, Trump told reporters, "I know the FBI is looking into" the affair but did not give further details on the investigation, or confirm when it was launched. Trump added he thought that Huang was an "honourable guy and I feel very confident that he will be in good shape" after the investigations. The FBI declined to comment when contacted by the BBC. Nvidia, which has commissioned an independent investigation into the affair involving Alice Huang, alleged to be a Chinese spy, said it had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised. Nvidia is the world's second most valuable company after Apple, and designs computer chips that have become central to AI technology. The revelations knocked about $250bn (£190bn) off Nvidia's value on Monday as the company's share price fell by more than 4%. US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. She is not related to Jensen Huang. According to the newspaper, Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a memo to top officials in Washington in spring this year, warning that the Nvidia boss was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy. - What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published9 hours ago - Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published13 hours ago Alice Huang was managing director of Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has had dealings with Nvidia. Trump's remarks are the first indication of whether Nvidia's Huang knew about the woman's alleged ties to Chinese espionage. Megaspeed's office in Singapore's central business district appeared to be operational and staffed on Tuesday. The BBC was refused entry to its floor, but spoke to a staff member by phone who said they had no comment and directed all queries to the company's PR team. The BBC has emailed Megaspeed several times for comment. Nvidia, co-founded by Jensen Huang, is also a major focus in the AI technology race between the US and China, with officials in Washington treating its exports to Beijing as a matter of national security - a key reason why Huang's affair has sparked concerns. Also on Monday, Huang and Nvidia were sued in a proposed class action lawsuit in California that accuses them of defrauding shareholders by concealing his ties with the suspected Chinese spy. The lawsuit alleges that the company lied to the media about Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, "who is suspected of seeking to help smuggle Nvidia products to China." The BBC has contacted Nvidia for comment on the lawsuit. 'An honourable guy' At the White House, Trump was asked several times when he was made aware of the relationship. He said he was informed "over a period of time" but was not specific. "I hope there's no problem, I believe he is suffering greatly," the president added. He said he spoke to Huang on the phone on Monday "just to see if he's feeling alright, how you doing and I asked him about that and he said he absolutely had no idea that the person in question was a spy". Trump has raised concerns that allowing China to lead in AI would supercharge Beijing's military and surveillance capabilities. The president added he was "sure" Chinese leader Xi Jinping would "ask me about it" when they next met. Huang has admitted that he was "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. He said on Monday that he was "committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security" and would cooperate with the investigation the company had launched. Huang has also been requested to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees next week, however it is unclear whether Huang will appear. A letter said the briefing would be "on Nvidia's security protocols against foreign adversary espionage and your interactions with a publicly reported People's Republic of China (PRC) intelligence asset: Megaspeed executive Alice Huang". Nvidia has declined to comment, while the the BBC has also contacted the committees. - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published11 hours ago - AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values - Published3 days ago Some workers the BBC spoke to at Nvidia's Santa Clara headquarters on Monday said it was business as usual, despite the intense attention on the company. Nvidia has been around for decades, with Huang founding it with two other engineers in 1993, but its rise to one of the world's most valuable and powerful companies has only been recent. It originally designed computer chips for gaming, but its decision to shift focus to AI development turned it into the powerhouse it is today. Its chips have become so valuable to the AI buildout that the White House previously imposed controls on where its advanced products could be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. But Huang has long been against restricting sales to China, arguing that it would be better for the global rollout of AI to be powered by US technology. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions. Nvidia's most advanced AI semiconductors including the GB200 Blackwell super chip remain blocked from the Chinese market. Additional reporting by Tessa Wong in Singapore - Published16 September - Published14 September

news.title: Borsada yükselişin adresi değişebilir: İşte öne çıkması beklenen sektörler
news.summary: Kuveyt Türk Yatırım Araştırma Direktörü Dr. Kutay Gözgör, Borsa İstanbul'da yükselişin devam edebileceğini belirterek kritik seviyelere dikkat çekti. Faiz indirimi beklentisi ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin etkisiyle önümüzdeki dönemde öne çıkabilecek sektörleri açıkladı.

news.titleTr: Borsada yükselişin adresi değişebilir: İşte öne çıkması beklenen sektörler
news.summaryTr: Kuveyt Türk Yatırım Araştırma Direktörü Dr. Kutay Gözgör, Borsa İstanbul'da yükselişin devam edebileceğini belirterek kritik seviyelere dikkat çekti. Faiz indirimi beklentisi ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin etkisiyle önümüzdeki dönemde öne çıkabilecek sektörleri açıkladı.
news.articleText: Borsada yükselişin adresi değişebilir: İşte öne çıkması beklenen sektörler - Kuveyt Türk Yatırım Araştırma Direktörü Dr. Kutay Gözgör, Borsa İstanbul'da yükselişin devam edebileceğini belirterek kritik seviyelere dikkat çekti. Faiz indirimi beklentisi ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin etkisiyle önümüzdeki dönemde öne çıkabilecek sektörleri açıkladı. Kuveyt Türk Yatırım Araştırma Direktörü Dr. Kutay Gözgör, CNBC-e ekranlarında yayınlanan Para Ekranı programında Şafak Tükle'nin sorularını yanıtladı. Borsa İstanbul'daki son yükselişi, Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası'nın (TCMB) faiz politikasını ve önümüzdeki dönemde öne çıkabilecek sektörleri değerlendiren Gözgör, endekste dip oluşumuna ilişkin ilk işaretlerin görülmeye başladığını ifade etti. Borsa İstanbul'da 12.500 seviyesi gündemde CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle BIST 100 endeksinde 14.000 seviyesinden başlayan düşüşün yaklaşık yüzde 26-27'lik değer kaybına yol açtığını hatırlatan Gözgör, piyasanın destek bulabileceği bölgenin belirginleşmeye başladığını söyledi. Endekste bir taban oluşumunun başladığını belirten Gözgör, mevcut hareketi tepki alımı ve dip arayışı olarak değerlendirdi. Gözgör, "Şu anlık tepki yükselişi olarak bakıyoruz. Devamı gelebilir. 12.500 bölgesine kadar gelmesi çok normal. Ancak bizi yeniden zirveye götürecek bir trend olduğunu söylemek için biraz daha izlememiz gerekiyor" dedi. Sert düşüşlerin ardından piyasaların genellikle doğrudan eski zirvelerine dönmediğini belirten Gözgör, endeksin önce yatay bir bant oluşturabileceğini, ardından gelişmelere bağlı olarak bu bandı yukarı kırarak yeni bir yükseliş trendine girebileceğini ifade etti. Gözgör, hızlı yükselişlerin sürdürülebilirliğinin zor olabileceğini belirterek daha kademeli bir toparlanmayı tercih ettiğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'ndan 100 baz puanlık faiz indirimi beklentisi TCMB'nin yaklaşan Enflasyon Raporu sunumuna ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Gözgör, aralık ayında 100 baz puanlık faiz indirimi öngördüklerini açıkladı. Faiz indirimi beklentisinin arkasında özellikle iç talepteki yavaşlamanın bulunduğunu belirten Gözgör, sanayi üretimi, PMI, konut ve otomotiv sektörlerindeki gelişmelerin ekonomik aktivitede soğumaya işaret ettiğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'nın haziran ayından bu yana iç talepteki gelişmelere daha fazla vurgu yaptığını ifade eden Gözgör, petrol fiyatlarındaki gerilemenin de para politikası açısından önemli olduğunu belirtti. Borsada hangi sektörler öne çıkabilir? Borsa İstanbul'da bilanço döneminin sona ermesinin ardından sektörel hareketlerin daha fazla önem kazanacağını belirten Gözgör, faiz indirimleri ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin sektör performanslarını belirleyebileceğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'nın faiz indirimlerine devam etmesi ve daha güvercin bir tutum benimsemesi halinde bankacılık, GYO ve çimento sektörlerinin öne çıkabileceğini ifade eden Gözgör, jeopolitik risklerin azalmasının ise havacılık sektörünü destekleyebileceğini belirtti. Gözgör, önümüzdeki dönemde endeks genelindeki hareketlerden ziyade ekonomik gelişmelere duyarlı sektörlerdeki fiyatlamaların daha belirgin hale gelebileceğini kaydetti. Bankacılık endeksi borsanın yönünü belirlemeye devam edecek Bankacılık endeksindeki yükselişi de değerlendiren Gözgör, sektörün makroekonomik görünüm açısından güçlü bir konumda bulunduğunu söyledi. Faiz indirimlerinin bankacılık sektörü üzerinde olumlu etkiler yaratabileceğini belirten Gözgör, yabancı yatırımcıların Türkiye piyasasına yeniden yönelmesi halinde bankaların öncelikli tercihler arasında yer alabileceğini ifade etti. Yabancı yatırımcıların içsel değeri ve büyüme potansiyeli bulunan şirketlere yönelebileceğini belirten Gözgör, bankacılığın yanı sıra holdingler, havacılık ve perakende sektörüne de dikkat çekti. Perakende tarafında BİM'i örnek gösteren Gözgör, yabancı yatırımcı ilgisinin bu tür büyük şirketlerde yoğunlaşabileceğini söyledi. Bankacılık sektörünün Borsa İstanbul açısından belirleyici rolünü koruyacağını vurgulayan Gözgör, "İlerleyen süreçte endeksin performansını belirleyecek en önemli sektör bankacılık endeksiydi ve bankacılık endeksi olmaya devam edecek" dedi.

Faiz indirimi beklentisinin arkasında özellikle iç talepteki yavaşlamanın bulunduğunu belirten Gözgör, sanayi üretimi, PMI, konut ve otomotiv sektörlerindeki gelişmelerin ekonomik aktivitede soğumaya işaret ettiğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'nın haziran ayından bu yana iç talepteki gelişmelere daha fazla vurgu yaptığını ifade eden Gözgör, petrol fiyatlarındaki gerilemenin de para politikası açısından önemli olduğunu belirtti. Borsada hangi sektörler öne çıkabilir? Borsa İstanbul'da bilanço döneminin sona ermesinin ardından sektörel hareketlerin daha fazla önem kazanacağını belirten Gözgör, faiz indirimleri ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin sektör performanslarını belirleyebileceğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'nın faiz indirimlerine devam etmesi ve daha güvercin bir tutum benimsemesi halinde bankacılık, GYO ve çimento sektörlerinin öne çıkabileceğini ifade eden Gözgör, jeopolitik risklerin azalmasının ise havacılık sektörünü destekleyebileceğini belirtti. Gözgör, önümüzdeki dönemde endeks genelindeki hareketlerden ziyade ekonomik gelişmelere duyarlı sektörlerdeki fiyatlamaların daha belirgin hale gelebileceğini kaydetti. Bankacılık endeksi borsanın yönünü belirlemeye devam edecek Bankacılık endeksindeki yükselişi de değerlendiren Gözgör, sektörün makroekonomik görünüm açısından güçlü bir konumda bulunduğunu söyledi. Faiz indirimlerinin bankacılık sektörü üzerinde olumlu etkiler yaratabileceğini belirten Gözgör, yabancı yatırımcıların Türkiye piyasasına yeniden yönelmesi halinde bankaların öncelikli tercihler arasında yer alabileceğini ifade etti. Yabancı yatırımcıların içsel değeri ve büyüme potansiyeli bulunan şirketlere yönelebileceğini belirten Gözgör, bankacılığın yanı sıra holdingler, havacılık ve perakende sektörüne de dikkat çekti. Perakende tarafında BİM'i örnek gösteren Gözgör, yabancı yatırımcı ilgisinin bu tür büyük şirketlerde yoğunlaşabileceğini söyledi. Bankacılık sektörünün Borsa İstanbul açısından belirleyici rolünü koruyacağını vurgulayan Gözgör, "İlerleyen süreçte endeksin performansını belirleyecek en önemli sektör bankacılık endeksiydi ve bankacılık endeksi olmaya devam edecek" dedi.

news.titleTr: Türkiye'de ürün denetimleri artıyor: 2027 hedefi 5 bin 100 parti
news.summaryTr: Ticaret Bakanlığının 2027 yılı bütçe teklifine göre, tüketicilerin sağlığını ve güvenliğini korumak amacıyla gelecek yıl 5 bin 100 parti ürün denetlenecek. Ürün güvenliği faaliyetleri için 1 milyar 464 milyon lira kaynak ayrılması planlanıyor.
news.articleText: Türkiye'de ürün denetimleri artıyor: 2027 hedefi 5 bin 100 parti - Ticaret Bakanlığının 2027 yılı bütçe teklifine göre, tüketicilerin sağlığını ve güvenliğini korumak amacıyla gelecek yıl 5 bin 100 parti ürün denetlenecek. Ürün güvenliği faaliyetleri için 1 milyar 464 milyon lira kaynak ayrılması planlanıyor. Türkiye'de tüketicilerin sağlığını, güvenliğini ve ekonomik çıkarlarını korumak amacıyla gelecek yıl 5 bin 100 parti ürünün denetlenmesi öngörülüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle AA muhabirinin Ticaret Bakanlığının 2027 Yılı Bütçe Teklifi'nden yaptığı derlemeye göre, Türkiye'de tüketicilere yönelik ürünlerin güvenli olup olmadığının tespiti amacıyla piyasa gözetimi ve denetimi faaliyetlerine devam ediliyor. Riskli sektörlere ve ürünlere odaklanılan bu denetimlerde, Avrupa Birliği (AB) mevzuatı uyumlaştırılarak oluşturulan ulusal mevzuatta düzenlenen ürünün kimyasal içeriği, fiziksel ve mekanik unsurları ile etiketleme hükümleri doğrultusunda incelemeler yapılıyor. Güvensiz ürünler kamuoyuyla paylaşılıyor Denetimler sonucu güvensiz olduğu tespit edilen ürünler, Güvensiz Ürün Bilgi Sistemi aracılığıyla kamuoyuna duyuruluyor. Ürünlerin mevzuata uygun şekilde piyasaya arzı için Bakanlığın gümrük ve dış ticaret bölge müdürlüklerinde oluşturulan "güvenli ürün danışma ofisleri" ile firmalara teknik mevzuata uyum konusunda destek veriliyor. Piyasaya arz edilen tüketici ürünlerinde risklerin ve güvensizliğin en aza indirilmesi için denetimlerin imalatçı ve ithalatçı odaklı yürütülmesi hedefleniyor. Ürün güvenliği mevzuatına yönelik farkındalığın artırılması amacıyla iktisadi işletmecilere yönelik rehberlik ve bilgilendirme çalışmalarına ağırlık verilmesi de planlanıyor. AB mevzuatı da dikkate alınarak gerekli durumlarda güncelleme çalışmaları ile denetim personelinin yetkinliğinin artırılması için rehberlik ve eğitim çalışmaları yapılması hedefleniyor. Ticarette teknik düzenlemeler önem kazanıyor Öte yandan, ihracata konu ürünlerin pazar ülkelerine girişinde uyması gereken standartların, teknik düzenlemelerin ve uygunluk değerlendirmelerinin önemi giderek artıyor. Bu doğrultuda ülke ticaretinde teknik engel oluşturan düzenlemelerin, Dünya Ticaret Örgütü Ticarette Teknik Engeller Komitesi toplantılarında gündeme getirilmesine ve ticari diplomasi faaliyetlerine devam edilmesi amaçlanıyor. Piyasa gözetimi ve denetim verileri ulusal sisteme aktarılacak Söz konusu hedefler doğrultusunda, tüketicilerin sağlığı ve güvenliği ile ekonomik çıkarlarını koruyucu, kayıplarını giderici tedbirler almak ve gerekli düzenlemeleri yapmak için bu yıl sonunda 5 bin parti ürünün denetlenmesi öngörülüyor. Bu sayının gelecek yıl 5 bin 100'e, 2028'de 5 bin 250'ye yükseltilmesi planlanıyor. Dış ticaret politikası, genel ekonomik hedefler ile kamu yararı doğrultusunda ürün politikalarının oluşturulması, uygulanması ve denetlenmesi doğrultusunda ihracat pazarındaki teknik mevzuat değişikliklerinin ilgili taraflara bildirim sayısının yıl sonuna kadar 39 bin 250 olması, gelecek yıl 44 bine çıkarılması amaçlanıyor. Piyasa gözetimi ve denetimi verilerinin de Ulusal Piyasa Gözetimi ve Denetimi Bilgi Sistemi'ne gelecek yıl tamamen taşınması hedefleniyor. Bu doğrultuda, gelecek yılın bütçesinden 1 milyar 464 milyon 615 bin lira kaynak ayrıldı.

news.title: Bakanlıktan peynir düzenlemesi: Üretimde ve piyasaya arzında yeni kurallar belirlendi
news.summary: Peynir üretimine yönelik düzenlemeyle süt proteini dışındaki proteinlerin kullanımı yasaklandı. Yeni kurallar kapsamında, çiğ veya hafif ısıl işlem uygulanmış sütten üretilen ve telemesi haşlanmamış peynirlerin piyasaya arz edilmesi için en az 4 ay olgunlaştırılması gerekecek.
