items.articleText: Hangi fon kazandırdı, hangisinden para çıktı? İşte haftanın tablosu - Yatırım fonlarında 3-9 Kasım döneminin getiri ve para akışı tablosu belli oldu. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL giriş yaşanırken bazı fonlardan milyarlarca lira çıkış gerçekleşti. Peki, haftanın en çok kazandıran fonları hangileri oldu, yatırımcılar hangi fonlara yöneldi? Yatırım fonlarında 3-9 Kasım dönemine ilişkin para akışı verileri, yatırımcıların tercihlerinde para piyasası fonlarının öne çıktığını gösterdi. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL net giriş yaşanırken, serbest fonlar ve kıymetli maden fonlarından çıkış kaydedildi. Haftalık getirilerde ise bazı para piyasası fonları yüzde 0,73'ün üzerine çıktı. Para piyasası fonlarına 28 milyar TL giriş CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 3-9 Kasım döneminde yatırım fonlarına toplam 8,3 milyar TL net para girişi gerçekleşti. Fon türleri arasında en yüksek giriş 28 milyar TL ile para piyasası fonlarında yaşandı. Para piyasası fonlarını 5,5 milyar TL ile serbest-hisse ve diğer fonlar, 1,7 milyar TL ile borçlanma araçları fonları izledi. Aynı dönemde en yüksek çıkış 20,6 milyar TL ile serbest-P/P kısa vadeli fonlarda gerçekleşti. Kıymetli maden fonlarından 3,4 milyar TL, değişken fonlardan 1 milyar TL, fon sepeti fonlarından ise 900 milyon TL çıkış yaşandı. Hisse senedi fonlarında 500 milyon TL, serbest-döviz fonlarında 400 milyon TL net çıkış kaydedildi. Para piyasası fonlarında en yüksek getiri hangisinde? Para piyasası fonlarının haftalık getiri sıralamasında İnveo Portföy tarafından yönetilen IPY fonu yüzde 0,7384 getiriyle ilk sırada yer aldı. IPY'nin mevduat eşdeğeri yıllık getiri oranı yüzde 38,50 olarak gösterildi. İkinci sırada yüzde 0,7349 haftalık getiriyle Atlas Portföy'ün PTP fonu bulunurken, Yapı Kredi Portföy'ün PPI fonu yüzde 0,7331 getiriyle üçüncü oldu. Nurol Portföy'ün PPN fonu yüzde 0,7288, Aktif Portföy'ün IDL fonu yüzde 0,7263 ve Ziraat Portföy'ün ZBJ fonu yüzde 0,7241 haftalık getiri sağladı. Garanti Portföy'ün GPZ fonunda haftalık getiri yüzde 0,7188, Deniz Portföy'ün DL2 fonunda yüzde 0,7168 ve Osmanlı Portföy'ün PLR fonunda yüzde 0,7112 olarak gerçekleşti. 5 fonun haftalık getirileri yüzde 0,7018 ile yüzde 0,7384 arasında değişirken, mevduat eşdeğeri yıllık getiri oranları yüzde 36,60 ile yüzde 38,50 arasında sıralandı. En fazla para girişi ve çıkışı yaşanan fonlar Fon bazında para akışında en yüksek giriş 18,46 milyar TL ile BGP fonunda gerçekleşti. BGP'yi 9,65 milyar TL ile ZBJ, 6,80 milyar TL ile KSV ve 3,70 milyar TL ile DLY takip etti. ZJI ve ZJB fonlarına ayrı ayrı 3,63 milyar TL giriş yaşanırken, KTV fonuna 2,53 milyar TL, ONS fonuna 2 milyar TL, DZM fonuna 1,80 milyar TL ve EUZ fonuna 1,47 milyar TL giriş kaydedildi. En fazla para çıkışı yaşanan fon ise 5,41 milyar TL ile DCB oldu. Bu fonu 3,09 milyar TL ile ZPR, 2,97 milyar TL ile KZL ve 2,85 milyar TL ile ONK izledi. PPJ fonundan 2,25 milyar TL, NSD fonundan 1,24 milyar TL ve ZPB fonundan 1,17 milyar TL çıkış gerçekleşti. DIP, IOO ve KLU fonları da en yüksek çıkış yaşanan ilk 10 fon arasında yer aldı.

items.title: ABD'den Lyft'e 53 milyon dolarlık dava: Engelli yolculara ayrımcılık suçlaması
items.summary: ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, engelli yolculara ayrımcılık yaptığı iddiasıyla ulaşım şirketi Lyft'e karşı 53 milyon dolarlık dava açtı. Şirket, hizmet hayvanı ve hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihaz kullanan yolculara hizmet vermemekle suçlanıyor.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: ABD'den Lyft'e 53 milyon dolarlık dava: Engelli yolculara ayrımcılık suçlaması
items.summaryTr: ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, engelli yolculara ayrımcılık yaptığı iddiasıyla ulaşım şirketi Lyft'e karşı 53 milyon dolarlık dava açtı. Şirket, hizmet hayvanı ve hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihaz kullanan yolculara hizmet vermemekle suçlanıyor.
items.articleText: ABD'den Lyft'e 53 milyon dolarlık dava: Engelli yolculara ayrımcılık suçlaması - ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, engelli yolculara ayrımcılık yaptığı iddiasıyla ulaşım şirketi Lyft'e karşı 53 milyon dolarlık dava açtı. - Şirket, hizmet hayvanı ve hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihaz kullanan yolculara hizmet vermemekle suçlanıyor. ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, ulaşım platformu Lyft hakkında engelli yolculara yönelik ayrımcılık iddiaları nedeniyle hukuki süreç başlattı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bakanlık, şirkete karşı 53 milyon dolar tutarında dava açtı. Dava dilekçesinde, Lyft ve sürücülerinin engelli yolcuların taşınmasını rutin olarak reddettiği öne sürüldü. Şirketin özellikle hizmet hayvanı kullanan veya hareket kolaylaştırıcı cihazlarla seyahat eden bireylere hizmet vermediği iddia edildi. Başvuruda ayrıca, hizmet talepleri hukuka aykırı şekilde reddedilen yolculardan iptal ücreti gibi ek bedeller tahsil edildiği belirtildi. Adalet Bakanlığı, Lyft'in engelli yolculara yönelik ayrımcılığı önlemek için gerekli durumlarda şirket kurallarında makul düzenlemeler yapmayı da reddettiğini ileri sürdü. ABD'de engelli bireylerin ulaşım hizmetlerine eşit erişimi, Engelli Amerikalılar Yasası (ADA) kapsamında korunuyor. Yasa, hizmet sağlayıcıların engelli bireylere yönelik ayrımcılık yapmasını yasaklıyor.

items.title: Honda'dan yeni hibrit SUV hamlesi: Avancier ilk kez görüntülendi
items.summary: Japon otomobil üreticisi Honda, yeni hibrit SUV modeli Avancier'in tasarımına ilişkin ilk ipuçlarını paylaştı. Üç sıra koltuk düzeniyle geniş aileleri hedeflemesi beklenen yeni model, markanın geliştirdiği hibrit teknolojisiyle yollara çıkmaya hazırlanıyor.

items.titleTr: Honda'dan yeni hibrit SUV hamlesi: Avancier ilk kez görüntülendi
items.summaryTr: Japon otomobil üreticisi Honda, yeni hibrit SUV modeli Avancier'in tasarımına ilişkin ilk ipuçlarını paylaştı. Üç sıra koltuk düzeniyle geniş aileleri hedeflemesi beklenen yeni model, markanın geliştirdiği hibrit teknolojisiyle yollara çıkmaya hazırlanıyor.
items.articleText: Honda'dan yeni hibrit SUV hamlesi: Avancier ilk kez görüntülendi - Japon otomobil üreticisi Honda, yeni hibrit SUV modeli Avancier'in tasarımına ilişkin ilk ipuçlarını paylaştı. Üç sıra koltuk düzeniyle geniş aileleri hedeflemesi beklenen yeni model, markanın geliştirdiği hibrit teknolojisiyle yollara çıkmaya hazırlanıyor. Honda'nın sosyal medya üzerinden yayımladığı tanıtım görseli, Avancier'in tasarım çizgilerini ortaya koydu. Station wagon modellerini andıran uzun gövde yapısını SUV özellikleriyle birleştiren otomobil, modern ve sportif görünümüyle dikkat çekiyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yeni modelde ince tasarımlı ön farlar, gövde boyunca uzanan belirgin omuz çizgisi ve L biçimindeki arka aydınlatmalar öne çıkıyor. Eğimli bagaj kapağı da otomobilin dinamik görünümünü tamamlıyor. Yeni hibrit teknolojisiyle gelecek Honda, Avancier'in yeni nesil Honda Hybrid güç aktarma sistemiyle donatılacağını doğruladı. Markanın mevcut e:HEV teknolojisinden farklı bir adlandırmayla duyurduğu sistemin teknik özelliklerinin kasım ayı içerisinde açıklanması bekleniyor. Otomobilin motor gücü, batarya kapasitesi, yakıt tüketimi ve performans değerleri hakkında ise henüz resmi bir bilgi bulunmuyor. Honda'dan 15 yeni hibrit model planı Avancier, Honda'nın önümüzdeki yıllara yönelik hibrit otomobil stratejisinin önemli parçalarından biri olacak. Şirket, 2027 yılından Mart 2030 sonuna kadar küresel pazarda 15 yeni nesil hibrit modeli satışa sunmayı hedefliyor. Bu araçlarda kullanılacak ortak platformun mevcut mimarilere kıyasla daha hafif ve daha dayanıklı olması planlanıyor. Honda ayrıca yeni hibrit modellerinde kullanılmak üzere elektrik destekli dört tekerlekten çekiş sistemi üzerinde çalışıyor. Ancak söz konusu teknolojinin Avancier'de yer alıp almayacağı henüz netleşmedi. 2027'de satışa çıkabilir Avancier ismi Honda için yeni değil. Marka, aynı adı ilk kez 1999 yılında Japonya pazarında satışa sunduğu Accord temelli station wagon modelinde kullanmıştı. Yeni Avancier ise üç sıra koltuklu SUV olarak farklı bir segmentte konumlanacak. Bölgesel basında yer alan bilgilere göre otomobilin 2027 yılında Avustralya'da satışa sunulması bekleniyor. Üretim için Tayland seçeneğinin değerlendirildiği de öne sürülüyor. Honda, modelin hangi ülkelerde satışa çıkacağını ve resmi lansman tarihini henüz duyurmadı.

Otomobilin motor gücü, batarya kapasitesi, yakıt tüketimi ve performans değerleri hakkında ise henüz resmi bir bilgi bulunmuyor. Honda'dan 15 yeni hibrit model planı Avancier, Honda'nın önümüzdeki yıllara yönelik hibrit otomobil stratejisinin önemli parçalarından biri olacak. Şirket, 2027 yılından Mart 2030 sonuna kadar küresel pazarda 15 yeni nesil hibrit modeli satışa sunmayı hedefliyor. Bu araçlarda kullanılacak ortak platformun mevcut mimarilere kıyasla daha hafif ve daha dayanıklı olması planlanıyor. Honda ayrıca yeni hibrit modellerinde kullanılmak üzere elektrik destekli dört tekerlekten çekiş sistemi üzerinde çalışıyor. Ancak söz konusu teknolojinin Avancier'de yer alıp almayacağı henüz netleşmedi. 2027'de satışa çıkabilir Avancier ismi Honda için yeni değil. Marka, aynı adı ilk kez 1999 yılında Japonya pazarında satışa sunduğu Accord temelli station wagon modelinde kullanmıştı. Yeni Avancier ise üç sıra koltuklu SUV olarak farklı bir segmentte konumlanacak. Bölgesel basında yer alan bilgilere göre otomobilin 2027 yılında Avustralya'da satışa sunulması bekleniyor. Üretim için Tayland seçeneğinin değerlendirildiği de öne sürülüyor. Honda, modelin hangi ülkelerde satışa çıkacağını ve resmi lansman tarihini henüz duyurmadı.

items.summary: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.

items.titleTr: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards'
items.summaryTr: The Congolese army's fight against rebel groups has long been hampered by disarray within its ranks.
items.articleText: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards' - Published At least 66 soldiers have been sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of Congo for cowardice, mutiny and refusing to obey orders, local media report. The sentences followed a trial of 71 soldiers before a military court in Walikale, in North Kivu province, in eastern DR Congo. Four soldiers were acquitted, while another was sentenced to 10 years in prison. The army said the trial was intended to improve discipline among troops as they battle armed groups in eastern DR Congo. The region has endured decades of conflict, with fighting continuing between government forces and the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN), a rebel coalition that includes the M23 group. The soldiers were reportedly arrested on 20 October in Walikale, where they were accused of abandoning their positions and fleeing during clashes with FRN fighters. The Congolese army's campaign against armed groups, including the M23, has long been undermined by poor discipline and disorganisation within its ranks. The government has repeatedly accused neighbouring Rwanda of supporting the M23, an allegation denied by both Kigali and the rebels despite overwhelming evidence. The army has faced persistent criticism over its lack of professionalism and disciplined, while soldiers have complained of poor pay and inadequate equipment. Last month, another 27 soldiers were sentenced to death on similar charges of cowardice after reportedly withdrawing from the frontline during clashes with rebels. In March 2024, DR Congo lifted a 20-year moratorium on the death penalty, citing the need to remove "traitors" within the army. The government said capital punishment would also apply to people involved in armed groups, insurrection, as well as committing treason and war crimes. The decision to reinstate the death penalty was widely criticised by rights groups. However, no formal executions have been carried out since the moratorium was lifted. Since the beginning of 2025, at least 507 soldiers have been convicted, including 381 death sentences, according to figures compiled by French broadcaster RFI. In October 2025, former Congolese President Joseph Kabila was sentenced to death in absentia on charges including war crimes and treason. He denied the accusations, but did not appear in court to defend himself. He has since been named as the FRN's leader. items.summary: Trump'ın İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını söylemesi ve petrol fiyatlarının gerilemesi Avrupa borsalarını destekledi. STOXX 600 yüzde 0,9 yükselirken havacılık hisselerinde de alımlar görüldü.

items.titleTr: Trump'ın İran açıklaması Avrupa piyasalarına yaradı: Borsalar yükselişte
items.summaryTr: Trump'ın İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını söylemesi ve petrol fiyatlarının gerilemesi Avrupa borsalarını destekledi. STOXX 600 yüzde 0,9 yükselirken havacılık hisselerinde de alımlar görüldü.
items.articleText: Trump'ın İran açıklaması Avrupa piyasalarına yaradı: Borsalar yükselişte - Trump'ın İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını söylemesi ve petrol fiyatlarının gerilemesi Avrupa borsalarını destekledi. STOXX 600 yüzde 0,9 yükselirken havacılık hisselerinde de alımlar görüldü. Avrupa borsaları, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu aşamada gerekli olmadığını belirtmesinin ardından petrol fiyatlarının gerilemesiyle güne yükselişle başladı. Bölge genelindeki alımlarla STOXX 600 endeksi rekor seviyesine yaklaştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa'nın gösterge endeksi STOXX 600, saat 11.05 itibarıyla yüzde 0,9 artışla 662,54 puana yükseldi. Almanya'da DAX, Fransa'da CAC 40 ve İtalya'da FTSE MIB endeksleri de yaklaşık yüzde 1 değer kazandı. STOXX 600, Ortadoğu'daki çatışmanın sona erebileceğine yönelik beklentilerin etkisiyle ağustos ayı başında gördüğü tarihi zirvenin yüzde 1'den daha az altında işlem gördü. Bölgedeki gerilimin azalabileceğine ilişkin beklentiler, enerji kaynaklı enflasyonun yavaşlayabileceği ve merkez bankalarının faiz artırımı baskısının hafifleyebileceği öngörülerini güçlendirdi. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı, Trump'ın açıklamalarının ardından yüzde 2'den fazla gerileyerek 90 dolar seviyesine indi. Petrol fiyatlarındaki düşüş, yüksek yakıt maliyetleriyle mücadele eden havacılık şirketlerinin hisselerine de olumlu yansıdı. Lufthansa hisseleri yüzde 1,8, Air France-KLM hisseleri yüzde 1,2 yükseldi. Şirket hisselerinde son durum Şirket bazında ise çip üreticisi Infineon'un hisseleri yüzde 3,1 değer kazandı. Şirket, veri merkezleri, enerji altyapısı ve yazılım tanımlı araçlardan gelen talebin etkisiyle 2027'de gelirlerinde yüzde 20'den fazla büyüme ve kârlılığında yaklaşık 5 puanlık artış beklediğini açıkladı. Gübre üreticisi K+S'nin hisseleri de üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarının piyasa beklentilerini aşmasının ardından yüzde 2,3 yükseldi. Not: Reuters'ın haberinde endeksin 662,54 puanlık seviyesi saat 08.05 GMT itibarıyla veriliyor. Bu nedenle metinde saat bilgisi yerine seans içi yükseliş aktarıldı.

items.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.summary: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.summaryTr: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
items.articleText: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published US President Donald Trump has said the FBI is investigating the affair between the chief executive of Nvidia and an alleged Chinese spy. Trump said he spoke to Jensen Huang on Monday following reports that the US believed he had been targeted in a Chinese espionage campaign. "I asked him that question, 'Did you have any idea she was a spy?' He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. Beijing has rejected claims that Huang was targeted, with its foreign ministry saying the allegations were "entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China". Speaking later at a White House press briefing, Trump told reporters, "I know the FBI is looking into" the affair but did not give further details on the investigation, or confirm when it was launched. Trump added he thought that Huang was an "honourable guy and I feel very confident that he will be in good shape" after the investigations. The FBI declined to comment when contacted by the BBC. Nvidia, which has commissioned an independent investigation into the affair involving Alice Huang, alleged to be a Chinese spy, said it had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised. Nvidia is the world's second most valuable company after Apple, and designs computer chips that have become central to AI technology. The revelations knocked about $250bn (£190bn) off Nvidia's value on Monday as the company's share price fell by more than 4%. US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. She is not related to Jensen Huang. According to the newspaper, Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a memo to top officials in Washington in spring this year, warning that the Nvidia boss was in a close relationship with a Chinese spy. - What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published9 hours ago - Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published13 hours ago Alice Huang was managing director of Singaporean company Megaspeed, which has had dealings with Nvidia. Trump's remarks are the first indication of whether Nvidia's Huang knew about the woman's alleged ties to Chinese espionage. Megaspeed's office in Singapore's central business district appeared to be operational and staffed on Tuesday. The BBC was refused entry to its floor, but spoke to a staff member by phone who said they had no comment and directed all queries to the company's PR team. The BBC has emailed Megaspeed several times for comment. Nvidia, co-founded by Jensen Huang, is also a major focus in the AI technology race between the US and China, with officials in Washington treating its exports to Beijing as a matter of national security - a key reason why Huang's affair has sparked concerns. Also on Monday, Huang and Nvidia were sued in a proposed class action lawsuit in California that accuses them of defrauding shareholders by concealing his ties with the suspected Chinese spy. The lawsuit alleges that the company lied to the media about Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, "who is suspected of seeking to help smuggle Nvidia products to China." The BBC has contacted Nvidia for comment on the lawsuit. 'An honourable guy' At the White House, Trump was asked several times when he was made aware of the relationship. He said he was informed "over a period of time" but was not specific. "I hope there's no problem, I believe he is suffering greatly," the president added. He said he spoke to Huang on the phone on Monday "just to see if he's feeling alright, how you doing and I asked him about that and he said he absolutely had no idea that the person in question was a spy". Trump has raised concerns that allowing China to lead in AI would supercharge Beijing's military and surveillance capabilities. The president added he was "sure" Chinese leader Xi Jinping would "ask me about it" when they next met. Huang has admitted that he was "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. He said on Monday that he was "committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security" and would cooperate with the investigation the company had launched. Huang has also been requested to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees next week, however it is unclear whether Huang will appear. A letter said the briefing would be "on Nvidia's security protocols against foreign adversary espionage and your interactions with a publicly reported People's Republic of China (PRC) intelligence asset: Megaspeed executive Alice Huang". Nvidia has declined to comment, while the the BBC has also contacted the committees. - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published11 hours ago - AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values - Published3 days ago Some workers the BBC spoke to at Nvidia's Santa Clara headquarters on Monday said it was business as usual, despite the intense attention on the company. Nvidia has been around for decades, with Huang founding it with two other engineers in 1993, but its rise to one of the world's most valuable and powerful companies has only been recent. It originally designed computer chips for gaming, but its decision to shift focus to AI development turned it into the powerhouse it is today. Its chips have become so valuable to the AI buildout that the White House previously imposed controls on where its advanced products could be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. But Huang has long been against restricting sales to China, arguing that it would be better for the global rollout of AI to be powered by US technology. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions. Nvidia's most advanced AI semiconductors including the GB200 Blackwell super chip remain blocked from the Chinese market. Additional reporting by Tessa Wong in Singapore - Published16 September - Published14 September

items.articleText: Borsada yükselişin adresi değişebilir: İşte öne çıkması beklenen sektörler - Kuveyt Türk Yatırım Araştırma Direktörü Dr. Kutay Gözgör, Borsa İstanbul'da yükselişin devam edebileceğini belirterek kritik seviyelere dikkat çekti. Faiz indirimi beklentisi ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin etkisiyle önümüzdeki dönemde öne çıkabilecek sektörleri açıkladı. Kuveyt Türk Yatırım Araştırma Direktörü Dr. Kutay Gözgör, CNBC-e ekranlarında yayınlanan Para Ekranı programında Şafak Tükle'nin sorularını yanıtladı. Borsa İstanbul'daki son yükselişi, Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası'nın (TCMB) faiz politikasını ve önümüzdeki dönemde öne çıkabilecek sektörleri değerlendiren Gözgör, endekste dip oluşumuna ilişkin ilk işaretlerin görülmeye başladığını ifade etti. Borsa İstanbul'da 12.500 seviyesi gündemde CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle BIST 100 endeksinde 14.000 seviyesinden başlayan düşüşün yaklaşık yüzde 26-27'lik değer kaybına yol açtığını hatırlatan Gözgör, piyasanın destek bulabileceği bölgenin belirginleşmeye başladığını söyledi. Endekste bir taban oluşumunun başladığını belirten Gözgör, mevcut hareketi tepki alımı ve dip arayışı olarak değerlendirdi. Gözgör, "Şu anlık tepki yükselişi olarak bakıyoruz. Devamı gelebilir. 12.500 bölgesine kadar gelmesi çok normal. Ancak bizi yeniden zirveye götürecek bir trend olduğunu söylemek için biraz daha izlememiz gerekiyor" dedi. Sert düşüşlerin ardından piyasaların genellikle doğrudan eski zirvelerine dönmediğini belirten Gözgör, endeksin önce yatay bir bant oluşturabileceğini, ardından gelişmelere bağlı olarak bu bandı yukarı kırarak yeni bir yükseliş trendine girebileceğini ifade etti. Gözgör, hızlı yükselişlerin sürdürülebilirliğinin zor olabileceğini belirterek daha kademeli bir toparlanmayı tercih ettiğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'ndan 100 baz puanlık faiz indirimi beklentisi TCMB'nin yaklaşan Enflasyon Raporu sunumuna ilişkin beklentilerini de paylaşan Gözgör, aralık ayında 100 baz puanlık faiz indirimi öngördüklerini açıkladı. Faiz indirimi beklentisinin arkasında özellikle iç talepteki yavaşlamanın bulunduğunu belirten Gözgör, sanayi üretimi, PMI, konut ve otomotiv sektörlerindeki gelişmelerin ekonomik aktivitede soğumaya işaret ettiğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'nın haziran ayından bu yana iç talepteki gelişmelere daha fazla vurgu yaptığını ifade eden Gözgör, petrol fiyatlarındaki gerilemenin de para politikası açısından önemli olduğunu belirtti. Borsada hangi sektörler öne çıkabilir? Borsa İstanbul'da bilanço döneminin sona ermesinin ardından sektörel hareketlerin daha fazla önem kazanacağını belirten Gözgör, faiz indirimleri ve jeopolitik gelişmelerin sektör performanslarını belirleyebileceğini söyledi. Merkez Bankası'nın faiz indirimlerine devam etmesi ve daha güvercin bir tutum benimsemesi halinde bankacılık, GYO ve çimento sektörlerinin öne çıkabileceğini ifade eden Gözgör, jeopolitik risklerin azalmasının ise havacılık sektörünü destekleyebileceğini belirtti. Gözgör, önümüzdeki dönemde endeks genelindeki hareketlerden ziyade ekonomik gelişmelere duyarlı sektörlerdeki fiyatlamaların daha belirgin hale gelebileceğini kaydetti. Bankacılık endeksi borsanın yönünü belirlemeye devam edecek Bankacılık endeksindeki yükselişi de değerlendiren Gözgör, sektörün makroekonomik görünüm açısından güçlü bir konumda bulunduğunu söyledi. Faiz indirimlerinin bankacılık sektörü üzerinde olumlu etkiler yaratabileceğini belirten Gözgör, yabancı yatırımcıların Türkiye piyasasına yeniden yönelmesi halinde bankaların öncelikli tercihler arasında yer alabileceğini ifade etti. Yabancı yatırımcıların içsel değeri ve büyüme potansiyeli bulunan şirketlere yönelebileceğini belirten Gözgör, bankacılığın yanı sıra holdingler, havacılık ve perakende sektörüne de dikkat çekti. Perakende tarafında BİM'i örnek gösteren Gözgör, yabancı yatırımcı ilgisinin bu tür büyük şirketlerde yoğunlaşabileceğini söyledi. Bankacılık sektörünün Borsa İstanbul açısından belirleyici rolünü koruyacağını vurgulayan Gözgör, "İlerleyen süreçte endeksin performansını belirleyecek en önemli sektör bankacılık endeksiydi ve bankacılık endeksi olmaya devam edecek" dedi.

items.articleText: Türkiye'de ürün denetimleri artıyor: 2027 hedefi 5 bin 100 parti - Ticaret Bakanlığının 2027 yılı bütçe teklifine göre, tüketicilerin sağlığını ve güvenliğini korumak amacıyla gelecek yıl 5 bin 100 parti ürün denetlenecek. Ürün güvenliği faaliyetleri için 1 milyar 464 milyon lira kaynak ayrılması planlanıyor. Türkiye'de tüketicilerin sağlığını, güvenliğini ve ekonomik çıkarlarını korumak amacıyla gelecek yıl 5 bin 100 parti ürünün denetlenmesi öngörülüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle AA muhabirinin Ticaret Bakanlığının 2027 Yılı Bütçe Teklifi'nden yaptığı derlemeye göre, Türkiye'de tüketicilere yönelik ürünlerin güvenli olup olmadığının tespiti amacıyla piyasa gözetimi ve denetimi faaliyetlerine devam ediliyor. Riskli sektörlere ve ürünlere odaklanılan bu denetimlerde, Avrupa Birliği (AB) mevzuatı uyumlaştırılarak oluşturulan ulusal mevzuatta düzenlenen ürünün kimyasal içeriği, fiziksel ve mekanik unsurları ile etiketleme hükümleri doğrultusunda incelemeler yapılıyor. Güvensiz ürünler kamuoyuyla paylaşılıyor Denetimler sonucu güvensiz olduğu tespit edilen ürünler, Güvensiz Ürün Bilgi Sistemi aracılığıyla kamuoyuna duyuruluyor. Ürünlerin mevzuata uygun şekilde piyasaya arzı için Bakanlığın gümrük ve dış ticaret bölge müdürlüklerinde oluşturulan "güvenli ürün danışma ofisleri" ile firmalara teknik mevzuata uyum konusunda destek veriliyor. Piyasaya arz edilen tüketici ürünlerinde risklerin ve güvensizliğin en aza indirilmesi için denetimlerin imalatçı ve ithalatçı odaklı yürütülmesi hedefleniyor. Ürün güvenliği mevzuatına yönelik farkındalığın artırılması amacıyla iktisadi işletmecilere yönelik rehberlik ve bilgilendirme çalışmalarına ağırlık verilmesi de planlanıyor. AB mevzuatı da dikkate alınarak gerekli durumlarda güncelleme çalışmaları ile denetim personelinin yetkinliğinin artırılması için rehberlik ve eğitim çalışmaları yapılması hedefleniyor. Ticarette teknik düzenlemeler önem kazanıyor Öte yandan, ihracata konu ürünlerin pazar ülkelerine girişinde uyması gereken standartların, teknik düzenlemelerin ve uygunluk değerlendirmelerinin önemi giderek artıyor. Bu doğrultuda ülke ticaretinde teknik engel oluşturan düzenlemelerin, Dünya Ticaret Örgütü Ticarette Teknik Engeller Komitesi toplantılarında gündeme getirilmesine ve ticari diplomasi faaliyetlerine devam edilmesi amaçlanıyor. Piyasa gözetimi ve denetim verileri ulusal sisteme aktarılacak Söz konusu hedefler doğrultusunda, tüketicilerin sağlığı ve güvenliği ile ekonomik çıkarlarını koruyucu, kayıplarını giderici tedbirler almak ve gerekli düzenlemeleri yapmak için bu yıl sonunda 5 bin parti ürünün denetlenmesi öngörülüyor. Bu sayının gelecek yıl 5 bin 100'e, 2028'de 5 bin 250'ye yükseltilmesi planlanıyor. Dış ticaret politikası, genel ekonomik hedefler ile kamu yararı doğrultusunda ürün politikalarının oluşturulması, uygulanması ve denetlenmesi doğrultusunda ihracat pazarındaki teknik mevzuat değişikliklerinin ilgili taraflara bildirim sayısının yıl sonuna kadar 39 bin 250 olması, gelecek yıl 44 bine çıkarılması amaçlanıyor. Piyasa gözetimi ve denetimi verilerinin de Ulusal Piyasa Gözetimi ve Denetimi Bilgi Sistemi'ne gelecek yıl tamamen taşınması hedefleniyor. Bu doğrultuda, gelecek yılın bütçesinden 1 milyar 464 milyon 615 bin lira kaynak ayrıldı.

items.articleText: Bakanlıktan peynir düzenlemesi: Üretimde ve piyasaya arzında yeni kurallar belirlendi - Peynir üretimine yönelik düzenlemeyle süt proteini dışındaki proteinlerin kullanımı yasaklandı. Yeni kurallar kapsamında, çiğ veya hafif ısıl işlem uygulanmış sütten üretilen ve telemesi haşlanmamış peynirlerin piyasaya arz edilmesi için en az 4 ay olgunlaştırılması gerekecek. - Düzenlemeye göre peynirler, muhafaza, taşıma ve piyasaya arz süreçlerinin tamamında 10 derecenin altındaki sıcaklıklarda tutulacak. Peynir üretiminde süt proteini dışındaki proteinler, nişasta ve nişasta bazlı ürünler, jelatin, soya ürünleri ile süt yağı dışındaki hayvansal ve bitkisel yağların kullanılması yasaklandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Tarım ve Orman Bakanlığınca hazırlanan, "Türk Gıda Kodeksi Peynir Tebliği", Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girerken 2015 tarihli tebliğ yürürlükten kaldırıldı. Yeni düzenlemeyle peynirlerin üretim, işleme, muhafaza, taşıma ve piyasaya arzına ilişkin kurallar yeniden belirlendi. Tebliğ kapsamında peynir üretiminde süt proteini dışındaki proteinler, nişasta ve nişasta bazlı ürünler, jelatin, soya ürünleri ile süt yağı dışındaki hayvansal ve bitkisel yağların kullanılması yasaklandı. Yalnızca çeşnili taze peynirlerde, stabilizör amacıyla teknolojinin izin verdiği miktarda nişasta kullanılabilecek. Çiğ sütten veya termizasyon (çiğ sütün işlenmeden veya pastörizasyondan önce raf ömrünü uzatmak ve içindeki mikroorganizma (bakteri) sayısını azaltmak amacıyla uygulanan hafif bir ısıl işlem) uygulanmış sütten üretilen, telemesi haşlanmamış peynirlerin, en az 4 ay olgunlaştırılmadan piyasaya arz edilmesine izin verilmeyecek. Olgunlaştırılmadan satışa sunulacak peynirlerde ise çiğ sütün en az pastörizasyon normlarında ısıl işlemden geçirilmesi gerekecek. Etiketlere 3 milimetre şartı getirildi Düzenlemeyle, peynir etiketlerine ilişkin kurallar da değişti. Ürünlerin yağlılık sınıfı ve olgunlaşma durumu, etiketlerde ürün adıyla birlikte belirtilecek. Olgunlaştırılarak piyasaya arz edilen peynirlerde üretim tarihi de gün, ay ve yıl şeklinde yer alacak. Ayrıca olgunlaştırma süresinin, etikette belirtilmesi zorunlu olacak. Etiketlerde "köy peyniri", "geleneksel peynir", "doğal peynir" ve "çiftlik peyniri" gibi nitelemeler kullanılamayacak. Farklı hayvan türlerinden elde edilen sütlerin karıştırılmasıyla üretilen peynirlerde ise kullanılan süt türleri, miktarlarına göre çoktan aza doğru sıralanarak belirtilecek. Çeşnili peynirlerde toplam çeşni oranı yüzde 6'yı, çeşnili taze peynirlerde ise yüzde 15'i geçemeyecek. Şeker kullanılan çeşnili taze peynirlerin etiketinde, ilave şeker oranına da yer verilecek. En az 120 gün süreyle olgunlaştırılarak üretilen kaşar peynirlerinde, "eski" ibaresi kullanılabilecek. Prosesinde pastörizasyona eşdeğer ısıl işlem bulunmayan çiğ sütten veya termizasyon uygulanan sütlerden üretilen telemesi haşlanmamış peynirlerin etiketlerinde, ürün adı ile aynı yüzde ve en az 3 milimetre punto büyüklüğünde "çiğ sütten üretilmiştir" ibaresi bulundurulacak. Tebliğ kapsamında yer alan ürünlerin etiketinde, peynirin piyasaya sunulduğu biçimine, üretim tekniğine, şekline ve kullanım amacına göre "sürülebilir", "ultrafiltrasyon", "üçgen", "tost, pizza yapımında kullanılabilir" gibi ibareler, tek başına ürün adı olarak kullanılmaması, ürün adı algısı oluşturulmaması ve ürün adının yazıldığı puntodan daha büyük puntoyla yazılmaması kaydıyla kullanılabilecek. İşletmelere uyum için 30 Nisan 2027'ye kadar süre verildi Peynirlerin muhafazası, taşınması ve piyasaya arzı sırasında 10 derecenin altındaki sıcaklıklarda tutulması zorunlu hale getirildi. Eritme peynirinin dökme olarak piyasaya arz edilmesi ve telemenin doğrudan tüketiciye sunulması da yasaklandı. Mevcut gıda işletmecilerine yeni hükümlere uyum sağlamaları için 30 Nisan 2027'ye kadar süre tanındı. Bu tarihten önce piyasaya arz edilen peynirler, raf ömrü sonuna kadar satışta kalabilecek. Ancak yeni düzenlemeye uygun olmayan dilimlenebilir eritme peynirleri, 30 Nisan 2027'den sonra piyasada bulundurulamayacak.

items.titleTr: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
items.summaryTr: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
items.articleText: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. BlackRock-backed tokenization platform Securitize agreed to buy River One, a New York financing firm, in a deal that would expand the tokenization company into asset-backed lending, the company said Monday. The deal would add a new financing layer to Securitize’s platform, expanding into asset-backed lending, according to a Monday release. River One is developing technology that would let lenders tap stablecoin funding. Lenders could use pools of small business loans or receivables as collateral to borrow money and fund new loans. The acquisition would give Securitize a role in arranging credit alongside its existing business issuing and servicing tokenized assets for firms such as BlackRock. The acquisition is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. Securitize ranks as the second-largest real-world asset (RWA) platform with $3.7 billion in total RWA value. Ondo ranks first with $4.1 billion, according to RWA.xyz. Securitize announced the deal alongside Q3 results. Revenue rose 13% from a year earlier to $18.6 million, while the company posted a $66.3 million net loss. Securitize said about $60 million of the loss reflected largely noncash expenses and accounting charges tied mainly to its business combination and public listing. Cointelegraph reached out to Securitize and River One for comment. Related: Securitize falls 16% after earnings miss, tokenization revenue drops

items.titleTr: Bitcoin için korkutan senaryo: Ünlü ekonomist yatırımcıları uyardı
items.summaryTr: Ekonomist Peter Schiff, küresel piyasalardaki toparlanmaya rağmen Bitcoin'in zayıf performans göstermesine dikkat çekerek sert düşüş uyarısında bulundu. Kritik destek seviyesinin kaybedildiğini belirten Schiff, yatırımcılara satış çağrısı yaptı.
items.articleText: Bitcoin için korkutan senaryo: Ünlü ekonomist yatırımcıları uyardı Ekonomist Peter Schiff, küresel piyasalardaki toparlanmaya rağmen Bitcoin'in zayıf performans göstermesine dikkat çekerek sert düşüş uyarısında bulundu. Kritik destek seviyesinin kaybedildiğini belirten Schiff, yatırımcılara satış çağrısı yaptı. ABD borsaları, teknoloji hisseleri, altın ve gümüş fiyatlarında toparlanma yaşanırken Bitcoin'in zayıf performans göstermesi, kripto para piyasasına yönelik endişeleri artırdı. Bitcoin, ABD ara seçimlerinin ardından kaydettiği yükselişin önemli bölümünü geri vererek 74-75 bin dolar aralığına geriledi. Bitcoin'e yönelik olumsuz görüşleriyle tanınan Peter Schiff, diğer yatırım araçlarındaki toparlanmaya rağmen kripto para biriminin güç kazanamamasını önemli bir uyarı işareti olarak değerlendirdi. Schiff, Bitcoin'in kritik destek seviyesini kaybettiğini belirterek yatırımcıların daha büyük kayıplarla karşılaşmadan satış yapmaları gerektiğini savundu. Ekonomist, 5 Kasım'da yaptığı açıklamada da Bitcoin'in bir balon olduğunu ileri sürerek yatırımcılara satış çağrısında bulunmuştu. Ancak Schiff'in geçmişte Bitcoin'in kalıcı çöküşüne ilişkin bazı tahminlerinin gerçekleşmediği biliniyor. Bitcoin ETF'lerinden 1,28 milyar dolarlık çıkış Bitcoin fiyatındaki düşüşe paralel olarak spot Bitcoin borsa yatırım fonlarında (ETF) da sermaye çıkışları hızlandı. Geçen hafta Bitcoin ETF'lerinden toplam 1,28 milyar dolarlık net çıkış gerçekleşirken bu rakam haziran sonundan bu yana en yüksek haftalık çıkış olarak kaydedildi. Son haftalardaki satışlarla birlikte Bitcoin ETF'lerinden yıl başından bu yana gerçekleşen kümülatif net çıkış yaklaşık 919 milyon dolara ulaştı. Ekim ayında ise fonlardan 515 milyon dolarlık net çıkış yaşanmıştı. Piyasalardaki satış baskısında Binance'in 6,3 milyar dolarlık siber saldırıya maruz kaldığına ilişkin gelişmeler, ABD ara seçimleri sonrasındaki belirsizlikler ve teknoloji hisselerindeki değer kayıpları etkili olan unsurlar arasında gösterildi.

items.titleTr: Sayıştay'dan istihdam açıklaması! Alınacak personeller için şartlar neler?
items.summaryTr: Sayıştay Başkanlığı, 3'ü çözümleyici, 13'ü programcı olmak üzere 16 sözleşmeli personel istihdam edecek.
items.articleText: Sayıştay'dan istihdam açıklaması! Alınacak personeller için şartlar neler? - Sayıştay Başkanlığı, 3'ü çözümleyici, 13'ü programcı olmak üzere 16 sözleşmeli personel istihdam edecek. - Kurumun Resmi Gazete'de yer alan ilanına göre, başvurular 11-25 Kasım tarihlerinde e-Devlet üzerinden alınacak. Sayıştay Başkanlığı'ından istihdam açıklaması geldi. Açıklamaya göre 3'ü çözümleyici, 13'ü programcı olmak üzere 16 sözleşmeli personel istihdam edecek. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kurumun Resmi Gazete'de yer alan ilanına göre, başvurular 11-25 Kasım tarihlerinde e-Devlet üzerinden "Sayıştay Başkanlığı-Kariyer Kapısı Kamu İşe Alım" veya Kariyer Kapısı (https://kariyerkapisi.gov.tr) internet sitesinden elektronik ortamda alınacak. Başvuruların değerlendirilmesinin ardından KPSS puan sıralamasına göre her pozisyon için alınacak personel sayısının 10 katı aday, sözlü sınava çağrılacak. Mesleki bilgi ve uygulamayı ölçmeye yönelik sözlü sınavda 70'in üzerinde puan alan adaylar başarılı sayılacak. Başarılı adaylar arasından pozisyon sayısı kadar asil ve aynı sayıda yedek aday belirlenecek. Sınava katılmaya hak kazananların listesi, sınav tarihi ve yeri Sayıştay Başkanlığının internet sitesinden duyurulacak.

items.title: Oxford museum returns ancestral Naga skulls to India
items.summary: The remains will be taken to Nagaland, where tribal leaders plan a joint memorial and burial.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Oxford museum returns ancestral Naga skulls to India
items.summaryTr: The remains will be taken to Nagaland, where tribal leaders plan a joint memorial and burial.
items.articleText: Oxford museum returns ancestral Naga skulls to India - Published The University of Oxford has returned the remains of 39 people taken from the Naga community during British colonial rule in India. A delegation of around 30 people from Nagaland, a mountainous state in north-eastern India, attended a ceremony at Oxford's Pitt Rivers Museum on Monday to mark the handover. The remains, most of which are skulls, will be taken back to India and given what Naga tribal leaders have described as a "respectful rest". There are plans to bury them under a joint memorial in a park in Nagaland. Museum director Laura Van Broekhoven described it as "a historic moment that will be part of stories told to next generations". She said the remains were finally on their way home after overcoming "so much red tape everywhere". The human remains were displayed at the Oxford museum for decades before being removed from public view in 2020 as part of what it described as a "decolonisation process". The Pitt Rivers Museum holds more than 6,000 objects associated with Naga culture, believed to be the largest such collection in the world. Most were acquired during British colonial rule in India and Myanmar (the former Burma). The museum's website lists 219 items as human remains. These were added to the museum's collection between 1910 and 1940 and mostly collected by two colonial administrators who were anthropologists. The museum's website, external mentions that the objects collected during this period were "frequently confiscated during punitive military expeditions, rather than freely given". During their visit to Oxford, the Naga delegation also met descendants of one of the anthropologists involved in collecting the remains. "The manner in which these human remains were taken away from our land leaves much for us to speculate," one of the tribal leaders, Thejao Vihienuo, told AFP. "I suspect that nobody would have given the skull of his father or his grandfather as a gift to another person." Anthropologists say that the Naga people once practised head hunting, severing the heads of enemies as trophies. But they also kept the heads of their own chiefs at the centre of villages. The Pitt Rivers Museum, founded in the 19th Century, has previously returned human remains to indigenous communities in Australia, New Zealand and the US. The latest handover to India concerns only the 39 ancestral remains and comes after a visit by a Naga delegation to Oxford in 2025, when it formally requested their return. The museum had announced in September that the remains would be returned to India.

items.title: Independent bookshop closing after rise in bills
items.summary: The Chicken and Frog in Brentwood says business rates and electricity bills have risen dramatically.

items.titleTr: Independent bookshop closing after rise in bills
items.summaryTr: The Chicken and Frog in Brentwood says business rates and electricity bills have risen dramatically.
items.articleText: Independent bookshop closing after rise in bills - Published An independent bookshop described as being a "haven" for families and neurodivergent children has announced it will close after 14 years. The Chicken and Frog says it will leave Brentwood town centre in January after a huge increase in its bills and business rates. Owner Natasha Radford, aka "Mrs Chicken", also says the town's footfall has been so low that at times she has gone a whole day without a sale. The 53-year-old said she had been busy since announcing the news, with customers coming in for a hug and a farewell. "It means the world because running your own business is difficult. It becomes all-consuming," said Radford, a former teacher. "So, to know that we've had a positive impact on people's lives... it's huge." The shop's absence will leave behind more than just empty bookshelves, as it runs workshops and provides a sensory space. Stephanie took her neurodivergent child to the shop and said the news was "truly heartbreaking" and that it would be an "immense loss" to Brentwood. The 36-year-old teacher described it as an "incredible haven" of "knowledge, support and community". "Natasha and her husband treated everyone who came into their shop as a close friend and went above and beyond to help," she said. "Her love for children and their wellbeing was felt in every part of that shop and every club and session she ran." - Budget 2026: Key points at a glance - Published28 October Radford said her profit margins were thin, and a book she typically bought in at £4.05 would then sell for £6.99. The business did not get the "deep discounts that the big boys get", she explained. On top of that, she said her electricity bills had tripled since first opening, and that what she paid annually in business rates had increased from £2,868 in 2024 to £8,435 this year. The amount many businesses are paying in rates has increased because the government reduced its temporary 75% "relief" discount, external to 40% in April 2025. Rates are also dictated by market rental value, and Radford pointed out that this disproportionately affected a town close to London like Brentwood. Radford said communities felt "fragmented" and allowing hubs to close was a "massive oversight" by the government. An HM Treasury spokesperson told the BBC that the autumn Budget gave High Street businesses "more breathing space". Traders will now only pay business rates once their rateable value reaches £18,000 - up from £12,000. However, the spokesperson accepted that some areas were "more expensive than others", meaning certain shops would not benefit. Rental value was a "commercial decision" between landlords and businesses, they added. Do you have a story suggestion for Essex? Contact us below. items.title: Holiday hunger bill to face final Stormont hurdle
items.summary: The new law would would help poorer families with food costs during school holidays.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Holiday hunger bill to face final Stormont hurdle
items.summaryTr: The new law would would help poorer families with food costs during school holidays.
items.articleText: Holiday hunger bill to face final Stormont hurdle - Published A proposed law which would help poorer families with food costs during school holidays is to face its final hurdle in the Northern Ireland Assembly later on Tuesday. Some parents and charities have welcomed the Holiday Meal Payments Bill, external, which was brought forward by Sinn Féin's Danny Baker. It would create a new payment for families whose children receive free school meals, which would be made outside of term time to help with the cost of food. But Democratic Unionist Party (DUP) Education Minister Paul Givan has been consistently critical of the legislation, warning it will immediately cost his budget £20m a year at a time when all departments are struggling financially. Why was the bill introduced? Baker said he was motivated to introduce it by some of his experiences of breakfast clubs and meal schemes in youth work. "There was a young boy, about the same age of my youngest, around seven years old," he explained. "He was filling his wee pockets up and we caught on to this. "To cut a long story short, he was bringing home food for his siblings because there just wasn't enough food in the house." Baker said all ministers had choices to make and the legislation alone could not solve child poverty, but would act as an "early intervention". Children are eligible for free school meals if their family's household income is below £15,390 a year. Northern Ireland is the only UK region without government-funded holiday food support, after the Department of Education (DE) ended its £27-per-fortnight holiday meal grant in 2023. Baker's legislation was introduced in the Northern Ireland Assembly in March and has been scrutinised by members of the legislative assembly (MLAs) on a number of occasions over the past nine months. What have campaigners and charities said? Community and voluntary groups have been publicly supportive of the bill, with some staging a demonstration at Stormont on Monday in a bid to urge MLAs to get it over the finish line. Louise McCullough, a mum-of-three from east Belfast, was among those who spoke at the event. She said her children receive free school meals and that she would be directly affected by the legislation. "There are so many working families who need this, it will change their lives and be massively impactful," she told BBC News NI. "I can't afford to work full time because of the cost of childcare, and the cost of living. "We have to do what we can and schemes like free school meals make a difference but so much more needs done... if you can't find money for hungry children what are you doing? "Our government should be scaffolding our families properly." Edel Diamond from the South West Belfast Foodbank said organisations like hers had been "filling in the gaps" to help struggling families. "We shouldn't have to - it's incumbent on our executive to put these initiatives forward," she said. "This will make such a difference to families we're seeing daily." What is the education minister's view? Paul Givan has previously warned that his department does not have funding for the scheme, so MLAs would be voting to cut education spending if they support it. Last month, his department tabled amendments that would have given him power to delay its implementation, but these were rejected by a majority of parties. On Monday, Democratic Unionist Party leader Gavin Robinson accused Sinn Féin of "reckless irresponsibility" over the proposed legislation. He branded the bill an "absurdity" when Stormont's finances were "already overstretched", but Sinn Féin argued it would give families "much-needed support". Robinson added: "This minister is already having to cut his cloth in a way that's going to be difficult and damaging for families." Ulster Unionist leader Jon Burrows said his party would not support the bill, saying that it was "undermining" the executive's case for asking London for additional funding to solve its budget impasse. Although the DUP and UUP are set to vote against the bill on Tuesday, Sinn Féin is expected to have enough support from Alliance and SDLP MLAs to ensure the bill passes. - Published30 March 2023 - Published12 October

items.title: New chief outlines main issues facing Isle of Man
items.summary: The chief minister says connectivity and food storage were among his top government priorities.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: New chief outlines main issues facing Isle of Man
items.summaryTr: The chief minister says connectivity and food storage were among his top government priorities.
items.articleText: New chief outlines main issues facing Isle of Man - Published The chief minister of the Isle of Man has said reliance on imports, risks of transport disruption, and pressure on household finances are among the main challenges facing the new government. The warning came after recent storms disrupted sea and air connections, and questions over how prepared the island is for more prolonged supply problems. Chris Thomas outlined plans to strengthen food security and connectivity, but said emergency preparedness was not among his top five priorities. The chief minister, ard-shirveishagh in Manx, said: "It is a serious issue. We need to improve connectivity through the airport and through Douglas Harbour." He said ensuring "the firms that bring our supplies to us... can get to the island will be a big focus for this government". He acknowledged that more needed to be done around emergency planning and public information, adding the government had held workshops on the issue in 2025 and would look to improve communication with residents. Food security One area of focus was reducing the island's reliance on imported food through greater support for local agriculture, Thomas said. He said one of his first meetings in the role was with the Manx National Farmers' Union, with discussions focusing on maximising local production and reducing supply risks. He also highlighted the need to improve storage and warehouse capacity. Thomas said there was "substantial building going on" on Cooil Road in Braddan, to "optimise the amount of storage we have". But the island's ability to maintain supplies remained closely linked to the reliability of its transport connections, he said. He said: "We had the worst possible situation at the end of October where we had some runway lights out on our airport and we had storms at the harbour." Improvements were needed at the airport, including air traffic control services, to help provide more reliable and affordable routes, he added. The ard-shirveishagh said sea connectivity was another priority, with the government facing ongoing questions about the Steam Packet's vessels and the suitability of the new vessel for Douglas Harbour. He confirmed that the purchase of another vessel remains on pause until harbour issues, including the need for dredging, have been addressed. Cost of living Thomas said putting more money back into people's pockets would be central to the government's approach, pointing to the increase in personal tax allowances introduced in the February budget. He argued that creating a "smaller, smarter, more efficient, more effective" government would help reduce pressure on taxpayers while allowing people to retain more of their income. He also acknowledged the impact of international events on fuel and food prices, and said the government needed to focus on tackling the underlying problems affecting people's lives. While he encouraged residents to take sensible steps to manage their own risks, he said household stockpiling was not something he wanted to make a major government priority. items.title: Poundland crisis 'could see all businesses suffer'
items.summary: Poundland has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators.

items.titleTr: Poundland crisis 'could see all businesses suffer'
items.summaryTr: Poundland has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators.
items.articleText: Poundland crisis 'could see all businesses suffer' - Published A potential collapse of Poundland could impact all businesses on the high street, a West Midlands business owner has said. Poundland has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators, which protects it from creditors until Thursday. Dr Lewis Haydon runs Raybloc, a radiation-shielding specialist firm in Willenhall. He told the BBC that it has been a challenging time for businesses over the past few years, especially since retailer Wilko collapsed in 2023. "It's a real shame because we need these people to be going to the high street. [It] is all about income - income for the people [and] income for the businesses on the high street. If that income, the cash flow, isn't there, all businesses suffer." Haydon added: "As an entrepreneur around that area, it's a real shame. Because we've grown up understanding the success stories about Poundland - how it started off as a market stall and it gets larger and larger to a national success. "It gives us a lot of uncertainty that this may happen to us as a business as well. "All the employees that we employ, they're all thinking: 'Could this happen to us as well?'" He added it was "not good news" this close to Christmas. Speaking to BBC Radio WM on Friday, Haydon said the move could also put pressure on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), who he said would struggle to hire those affected by the collapse. "If there's another 12,000 people looking for work in the community, it puts pressure on us, the small and medium-sized enterprises, to employ more people." Poundland founder, Steve Smith, said two or three thousand suppliers, particularly those that work exclusively with Poundland, would also be caught up in any collapse. A second buyer, London-based Xyra Group, has made a rescue bid for the discount retailer as it teeters on the brink of collapse. US-based owner Gordon Brothers has already rejected a rival bid from an Irish property group which would have saved its 12,000 staff. Gordon Brothers said the business has faced years of instability and "remains challenged and vulnerable". Sources familiar with Xyra's offer said the firm is proposing to immediately pay off £12.5 million of an outstanding £30 million loan on Poundland's books. Gordon Brothers, which bought Poundland for £1 last June, committed at the meeting to prioritising offers that protect its stores and workforce. 'We need to stop decline of the high street' Raj Kandola, from The Black Country Chamber of Commerce, said the impact on people's livelihood "doesn't bear thinking about" and called on the government to help find a solution. "It comes down to the government creating a platform which helps businesses flourish, looking at how we can reform business rates even further to stop this decline of the high street." While the uncertainty lingers, Kandola said there is still hope for the region. "Businesses across the Black Country remain very resilient. In the last 10 years they have seen the fallout from Brexit, Covid-19, the energy price hike following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and the majority of them still continue to display remarkable amount of resilience and continue to move forward." "There are obviously very wide ranging concerns but we shouldn't lose sight of the fact that the Black Country remains open for business." Poundland has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators, which protects it from creditors until Thursday. Dr Lewis Haydon runs Raybloc, a radiation-shielding specialist firm in Willenhall. He told the BBC that it has been a challenging time for businesses over the past few years, especially since retailer Wilko collapsed in 2023. "It's a real shame because we need these people to be going to the high street. [It] is all about income - income for the people [and] income for the businesses on the high street. If that income, the cash flow, isn't there, all businesses suffer." Haydon added: "As an entrepreneur around that area, it's a real shame. Because we've grown up understanding the success stories about Poundland - how it started off as a market stall and it gets larger and larger to a national success. "It gives us a lot of uncertainty that this may happen to us as a business as well. "All the employees that we employ, they're all thinking: 'Could this happen to us as well?'" He added it was "not good news" this close to Christmas. Speaking to BBC Radio WM on Friday, Haydon said the move could also put pressure on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), who he said would struggle to hire those affected by the collapse. "If there's another 12,000 people looking for work in the community, it puts pressure on us, the small and medium-sized enterprises, to employ more people." Poundland founder, Steve Smith, said two or three thousand suppliers, particularly those that work exclusively with Poundland, would also be caught up in any collapse. A second buyer, London-based Xyra Group, has made a rescue bid for the discount retailer as it teeters on the brink of collapse. US-based owner Gordon Brothers has already rejected a rival bid from an Irish property group which would have saved its 12,000 staff. Gordon Brothers said the business has faced years of instability and "remains challenged and vulnerable". Sources familiar with Xyra's offer said the firm is proposing to immediately pay off £12.5 million of an outstanding £30 million loan on Poundland's books. Gordon Brothers, which bought Poundland for £1 last June, committed at the meeting to prioritising offers that protect its stores and workforce. 'We need to stop decline of the high street' Raj Kandola, from The Black Country Chamber of Commerce, said the impact on people's livelihood "doesn't bear thinking about" and called on the government to help find a solution. "It comes down to the government creating a platform which helps businesses flourish, looking at how we can reform business rates even further to stop this decline of the high street." While the uncertainty lingers, Kandola said there is still hope for the region. "Businesses across the Black Country remain very resilient. In the last 10 years they have seen the fallout from Brexit, Covid-19, the energy price hike following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and the majority of them still continue to display remarkable amount of resilience and continue to move forward." "There are obviously very wide ranging concerns but we shouldn't lose sight of the fact that the Black Country remains open for business." items.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, cybersecurity firm CertiK urged exchanges to impose hard dollar limits on hot-wallet holdings following the $6.3 billion Binance hack, blockchain analytics firm Elliptic reported that North Korean hackers used newly created memecoins to launder stolen funds and European regulators sought industry participants to help establish common standards for tokenized securities. Crypto exchanges need dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says Crypto exchanges should impose hard dollar limits on their hot-wallet holdings rather than relying solely on cold-storage ratios to measure security, according to cybersecurity firm CertiK. The recommendation came as several crypto exchanges recently disclosed how much they held in cold wallets, seeking to reassure customers after the record Binance hack that targeted its hot wallets. Crypto exchange Gate reported that 88.26% of its total assets were in cold storage, while Coinbase said it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline. “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” CertiK’s research team told Cointelegraph. CertiK said crypto exchanges should consider setting hot-wallet caps for each asset and blockchain according to the strictest of three limits: a percentage of customer liabilities, estimated withdrawal needs and an absolute loss ceiling based on the exchange’s financial resources and recovery capabilities. “Flexibility should support operating liquidity, while hard dollar ceilings and circuit breakers limit potential loss,” they said. North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic North Korean hackers created memecoins to launder cryptocurrency stolen in the $6.3 billion Binance hack, routing roughly $430,000 through six newly launched tokens on the NEAR blockchain, according to a report from blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the hackers created at least six tokens on NEAR and used liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges to move stolen funds between wallets, Elliptic said. The tokens attracted almost no outside trading and were abandoned shortly after launch. The hackers used one set of wallets to swap stolen NEAR tokens for the new memecoins, then used another set to sell those memecoins back into the pools for NEAR. The swaps let them move funds without direct wallet-to-wallet transfers, though the transactions remained traceable onchain. Elliptic said the same laundering technique was also used following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, when North Korean-linked actors moved at least $24 million through a newly created token on the TRON blockchain. EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities The European Central Bank, European Commission and European Securities and Markets Authority are seeking nominations for an industry-led group that will draft common standards for holding and settling tokenized securities. Eligible applicants include EU industry associations, global institutions, private firms and fintech companies. They can apply to the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) by Nov. 27, with work set to begin in January 2027, according to a release published Monday. The three EU institutions will participate as observers. The group will develop technical and market standards to help companies hold and settle tokenized securities across different distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms and ensure those platforms can work with existing financial systems. The group aims to produce an initial set of standards by early 2028, according to its mandate. The standards will support Appia, the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop a blueprint for Europe’s tokenized financial markets. The institutions warned that fragmentation could limit the benefits of tokenization and said the group may recommend ways for EU authorities to encourage firms to adopt its standards. In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets in central bank money.

items.titleTr: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims
items.summaryTr: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by Saturday's attack, writes Sarah Rainsford.
items.articleText: Polish unity on show as thousands join silent march for Krakow shooting victims - Published Thousands of people joined a silent march through central Krakow on Monday night, in memory of those killed and injured when a gunman went on a violent rampage at the weekend. The crowd were led by Poland's president and prime minister, the bitter political rivals putting on a rare show of unity after the country's deadliest attack in modern times. As they reached the historic Market Square, a bugler played from the tower. Many people were carrying flowers or candles to leave at the shrines that now dot the cobblestones, each one marking a spot where someone died. Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by this attack. It has left people struggling to make some kind of sense of what happened. The alleged gunman has been named as 24-year-old Michal Oksinski by local media. Critically injured in a shoot-out with police, he did not regain consciousness and died in hospital early on Monday. Initially, the interior minister claimed that Oksinski was driven by far-right, extremist views. The national prosecutor's office now says that it is too soon to say he was "inspired" by any ideology. "The minister wanted to win domestic political points. That's not responsible behaviour," Pawel Musialek of the Jagiellonian University suggests, in a country where politics is highly - and often viciously - polarised. "So far we've seen no clear message that this guy was strongly ideological, and that it's not more like something from the darknet." There has been no mention of any letter or manifesto that Oksinski left. One neighbour told Polish news site Onet that the 24-year-old was a "bit of a loner" but few who knew him well have spoken publicly. - What we know so far after Krakow gun attack - Published17 hours ago In addition to his electronic devices like his phone, investigators are examining a number of badges that Oksinski had attached to his military-style outfit. The prosecutor's office says a yellow Gadsden flag with a coiled snake symbol was displayed in his bedroom. "It has various meanings of freedom and rebellion," a spokesman emphasised. "Not necessarily negative." It was at Oksinski's home that the bodies of his parents and sister were discovered. It is alleged that he shot them, before driving some 200km (125 miles) south to continue the killing in Krakow. Two days on, shops and cafes around the market square are beginning to fill up again, but the mood is subdued. A Zara clothes shop is still boarded up, after bullets smashed the glass. A local man in his 50s died just outside. Jo, a Scottish tourist, saw paramedics "who got there ridiculously fast", fighting to save him. "It was all pretty grim." Like many, she initially mistook the rifle shots for fireworks. On the opposite corner of the square, beside another cluster of flowers, people keep pausing to take pictures of the holes that were blasted into the wall by gunfire. One of the six victims has been identified as a Polish painter in her 50s, who was a mother of four, and in town with friends for an exhibition opening. A British citizen and an Austrian who died are yet to be named publicly. Several drivers of the horse-drawn carriages that are usually poised to trot tourists around the square were seriously injured. Olha, who works in a nearby chocolate shop says everyone is now nervous. On Saturday, people rushed into her store to escape the gunman who was tearing around in his car, firing through the window. Olha is Ukrainian, and moved to Krakow when Russia invaded. "We left our own country for safety. This is supposed to be a safe place!" she said. "It's so sad, and so scary. Especially that he drove all the way here for two hours, planning this and thinking about it." She regrets that the gunman did not survive: "So many are dead, so many lives have been ruined, and now there will be no justice." When Oksinski's car was searched, four firearms and "hundreds of rounds of ammunition" were found, all owned legally by the alleged killer and his father. Both were members of the Swit Starachowice sports club, where there is a shooting range. A spokesman recalls Michal Oksinski as unremarkable: average competition results and normal behaviour. He had been just three times this year, most recently in August with his father. The club spokesman is adamant that it does not train combat firing, only shooting from a fixed point. Gun ownership in Poland has grown considerably since war broke out in Ukraine just across the border, but this is the first mass shooting anyone here can remember. Inevitably, it has brought scrutiny of the checks over who qualifies to handle such weapons, including psychological tests, as Michal Oksinski passed all of them. On Monday, the government announced an urgent review. At the spot where Oksinski's car was intercepted and he was shot by police there is another memorial, this one in honour of the officers still in hospital. Some have brought flowers, but a girl called Bianka has left a card that reads: "Thank you Mr Policemen, get better soon." A couple of steps away, there's a series of bullet holes in the glass. "This man was a real hero, he didn't hesitate," Ania says, referring to officer Jakub Kulik who was shot in the chest. His condition remains serious. "We're here to help him fight for his life." "Nothing like this has never happened before, it's terrible," a young man called Wojtek tells me. He's only glad that the gunman responsible for such horror turned out to be Polish. "People here are already against immigration, so that would have been even worse." Ania thinks Poles will pull through, though the country's image as a low-crime oasis has been shattered. Most of all, she's angry that Michal Oksinski died without being held to account for the devastation. "I think we deserve to know why." - Published2 days ago - Published21 hours ago - Published1 day ago

items.articleText: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses. Update (Nov. 10, 2026, 7:31 am UTC): This article has been updated to include details of MARA’s $1.1 billion Bitcoin sale and its repayment of $750 million in Bitcoin-backed loans. HIVE Digital Technologies and MARA Holdings mined more Bitcoin in the September quarter than a year earlier but reported lower mining revenue, as weaker Bitcoin prices outweighed gains in production. According to their latest regulatory filings, HIVE’s Bitcoin production increased 49% to 1,070 Bitcoin (BTC), while mining revenue fell 7.4% to $76 million. MARA reported a similar pattern, with production rising 5% to 2,247 BTC and Bitcoin mining revenue dropping 34% to $159 million. MARA also disclosed that it sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1 billion after the quarter ended Sept. 30. It used $750 million of the proceeds to repay its Bitcoin-backed term loans in full, releasing 17,477 BTC it had pledged as collateral. Both companies reported higher power bills and equipment charges. HIVE’s electricity costs rose 20% to $45.6 million, while MARA’s purchased energy costs increased 12% to $48.1 million as it expanded its owned mining operations. HIVE also recorded a $31.2 million noncash write-down on mining equipment, citing “depressed mining economics,” while MARA separately wrote off $12 million involving mining rigs and equipment under restructuring plans. Both results add to signs of pressure on Bitcoin mining economics. American Bitcoin last week reported weaker mining margins despite a treasury-driven quarterly profit, while Core Scientific said it plans to leave mining entirely by year-end. HIVE and MARA expand AI businesses alongside mining Unlike Core Scientific, HIVE and MARA are both continuing to invest in Bitcoin mining alongside artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. HIVE’s HPC hosting revenue rose 71% to $8.8 million in the September quarter, accounting for 10.4% of total revenue. The company has described its strategy as combining cash flow from mining with recurring revenue from AI infrastructure. Related: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI HIVE said it anticipates spending up to $493 million over 36 months to expand its HPC operations, including acquiring land, building out data center infrastructure and buying up GPUs. The company reported spending $145.3 million toward that expansion as of the filing. HIVE also plans to spend about $35 million converting its Toronto facility into a Tier-III data center. Meanwhile, it continues to expand its mining infrastructure, targeting a 100-megawatt substation expansion at its Yguazú site in Paraguay during 2026. MARA is also developing AI infrastructure through its Exaion subsidiary and a partnership with Starwood Digital Ventures. It said it intends to operate sites that can shift between workloads depending on economics, demand and grid conditions, with Bitcoin mining remaining the foundation of its platform. Treasury gains lift MARA profit, HIVE reports quarterly loss HIVE’s Nasdaq-listed shares fell 1.7% to $1.78 in after-hours trading Monday, according to Google Finance, after closing the regular session up 1.7% at $1.81. The company reported fiscal second-quarter revenue of $84.9 million, down 2.7% from a year earlier but above the $79.4 million consensus estimate listed by MarketBeat. Meanwhile, MARA reported net income attributable to common stockholders of $634.4 million, up from $123.1 million a year earlier, and included substantial fair-value gains on digital assets and digital asset receivables. MARA reported quarterly revenue of $164.2 million, down 35% year-on-year, and diluted earnings of $1.28 a share, up from 27 cents, while its shares were little changed at $6.64 in after-hours trading Monday after closing up 4.6%. It used $750 million of the proceeds to repay its Bitcoin-backed term loans in full, releasing 17,477 BTC it had pledged as collateral. Both companies reported higher power bills and equipment charges. HIVE’s electricity costs rose 20% to $45.6 million, while MARA’s purchased energy costs increased 12% to $48.1 million as it expanded its owned mining operations. HIVE also recorded a $31.2 million noncash write-down on mining equipment, citing “depressed mining economics,” while MARA separately wrote off $12 million involving mining rigs and equipment under restructuring plans. Both results add to signs of pressure on Bitcoin mining economics. American Bitcoin last week reported weaker mining margins despite a treasury-driven quarterly profit, while Core Scientific said it plans to leave mining entirely by year-end. HIVE and MARA expand AI businesses alongside mining Unlike Core Scientific, HIVE and MARA are both continuing to invest in Bitcoin mining alongside artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. HIVE’s HPC hosting revenue rose 71% to $8.8 million in the September quarter, accounting for 10.4% of total revenue. The company has described its strategy as combining cash flow from mining with recurring revenue from AI infrastructure. Related: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI HIVE said it anticipates spending up to $493 million over 36 months to expand its HPC operations, including acquiring land, building out data center infrastructure and buying up GPUs. The company reported spending $145.3 million toward that expansion as of the filing. HIVE also plans to spend about $35 million converting its Toronto facility into a Tier-III data center. Meanwhile, it continues to expand its mining infrastructure, targeting a 100-megawatt substation expansion at its Yguazú site in Paraguay during 2026. MARA is also developing AI infrastructure through its Exaion subsidiary and a partnership with Starwood Digital Ventures. It said it intends to operate sites that can shift between workloads depending on economics, demand and grid conditions, with Bitcoin mining remaining the foundation of its platform. Treasury gains lift MARA profit, HIVE reports quarterly loss HIVE’s Nasdaq-listed shares fell 1.7% to $1.78 in after-hours trading Monday, according to Google Finance, after closing the regular session up 1.7% at $1.81. The company reported fiscal second-quarter revenue of $84.9 million, down 2.7% from a year earlier but above the $79.4 million consensus estimate listed by MarketBeat. Meanwhile, MARA reported net income attributable to common stockholders of $634.4 million, up from $123.1 million a year earlier, and included substantial fair-value gains on digital assets and digital asset receivables. MARA reported quarterly revenue of $164.2 million, down 35% year-on-year, and diluted earnings of $1.28 a share, up from 27 cents, while its shares were little changed at $6.64 in after-hours trading Monday after closing up 4.6%.
